jobs.title: Forward Developed Engineer
jobs.description: **Forward Deployed Engineer** **— Banking Platform** *Ship it, then go sit with the people using it. · Charlotte, NC* **Location** Charlotte, NC — on\-site at our headquarters, with travel to partner and client sites **Experience Required** 5\+ years building and shipping production software, including meaningful time in financial services and hands\-on experience building with Claude **Employment Type** Full\-time, exempt **Reports To** Technical Program Manager **Direct Reports** None. You work across engineering, product, operations, and directly with external partners. **Core Stack** React, Flutter, AWS, GitHub Actions, Claude (Claude Code and the Claude API) **Portfolio** Expected — see "Show Us Your Work" below **The Trade We're Offering** ============================ We're a smaller institution headquartered in a city full of very large ones, and we're not going to pretend we can match what the largest of them offer on every dimension. What we're offering instead is scope that those jobs structurally cannot give you. At a large bank, this work is split across four teams — a mobile team, a web team, a platform team, and a client\-facing integration group — and you'd own a lane in one of them. **Here, the whole path from commit to customer is yours.** You'll write the Flutter code, write the React code, own the pipeline that ships both, and then sit across the table from the people using what you built and watch where it breaks. Engineers who want that loop rarely get it at scale. If that's the job you've been trying to find, this is it.**About the Role** ================== We're hiring a Forward Deployed Engineer to build our banking platform and then take it into the field. This is a hybrid of product engineering and client\-facing solutions work: roughly two\-thirds building, one\-third embedded with the partners, vendors, and internal teams who depend on what you ship. The forward\-deployed part is the point. Most engineering organizations put layers between the person who writes the code and the person who has to live with it, and quality suffers in both directions. You'll close that gap. When an integration fails at a partner, you're the one who diagnoses it — not a support tier that escalates to a queue that eventually reaches engineering three days later. We also expect this person to be genuinely fluent with Claude — not as a novelty, but as core tooling. A small team competing against institutions a hundred times our size only works if each engineer's output is multiplied. You should already be building this way and be able to show us how. You'll work closely with the Senior Product Manager who owns the banking portfolio, and you'll have real influence over technical direction. We have opinions but not much legacy, which means your architectural decisions will still be standing in five years.**What You'll Own** =================== **Mobile Development — Flutter** -------------------------------- * Build and ship our customer\-facing mobile banking application in Flutter across iOS and Android. * Own the release process end to end — store submissions, staged rollouts, versioning, and the deprecation strategy for older clients. * Handle the parts of mobile banking that are genuinely hard: biometric authentication, secure local storage, session handling, offline states, and deep links from notifications. * Keep performance and app size honest on the low\-end devices real customers actually carry. **Web Development — React** --------------------------- * Build customer\-facing web banking experiences and the internal tooling our operations teams use daily. * Share logic and design language across web and mobile so the two products don't quietly diverge. * Build to accessibility standards — WCAG conformance is a regulatory expectation in consumer banking, not a nice\-to\-have. **Cloud Infrastructure — AWS** ------------------------------ * Design, deploy, and operate services on AWS — compute, storage, networking, secrets, and identity. * Own infrastructure as code so environments are reproducible and auditable rather than hand\-assembled. * Build for the availability and recovery expectations of a regulated financial institution, and be able to prove them to an examiner. * Watch the bill. Cloud cost discipline matters more at our size than it does at a bank that can absorb the waste. **Delivery Engineering — GitHub Actions** ----------------------------------------- * Own the CI/CD pipelines for web, mobile, and backend services. * Build automated testing, security scanning, dependency checks, and deployment gates into the pipeline. * Maintain the change controls and audit trail that a regulated environment requires — approvals, artifacts, and release evidence. * Make shipping boring. A deployment should be an ordinary Tuesday, not an event. **AI\-Assisted Engineering — Claude** ------------------------------------- * Use Claude Code as a daily part of how you build — across the codebase, in your at You Get Here** **What You Won't Get Here** The full path from commit to customer, owned by one person Anywhere to hide when something you shipped breaks Architectural decisions that will still be standing in five years A platform team that handles infrastructure so you don't have to Direct contact with the people using what you build Insulation from customers when a deploy goes badly Deploys in days, not release trains scheduled a quarter out A mature engineering organization with established process Genuine influence on technical direction from your first month Deep specialization — you'll work across mobile, web, cloud, and AI A mandate to define how a company uses AI, not to inherit someone's rules An existing AI platform team, or someone else's guardrails to inherit Budget for conferences, certifications, and continued learning A remote or fully flexible arrangement — this role is on\-site **Education** ============= * Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, or a related field — or equivalent practical experience. * **No degree requirement we'll hold rigidly.** Show us what you've shipped. Self\-taught engineers with production track records are welcome here. * AWS certifications are a plus and are not required. **Work Environment** ==================== On\-site at our Charlotte headquarters, Monday through Friday, standard business hours. Expect periodic travel to partner and client sites — typically a few days at a time, several times a year. Banking platform work occasionally means an evening or a weekend around a release, a core conversion, or an incident. We run a real on\-call rotation and we keep it humane.**Show Us Your Work** ===================== We ask candidates for this role to share code. A resume tells us where you've been; a repository tells us how you think. Send us **one or two repositories you've built** — ideally something involving Claude, a mobile or web application, or infrastructure you're proud of. Personal projects, open\-source contributions, and side work all count. **If your best work is proprietary, that is not a disqualifier.** Most engineers coming out of financial services cannot share what they built, and we're not going to penalize you for honoring an agreement you signed. In that case, tell us and we'll substitute a walkthrough conversation — you talk us through the architecture of something you built, the trade\-offs you made, and what you'd do differently. That serves the same purpose. What we're looking for either way: how you structure a project, how you handle the unglamorous parts, whether the README exists, and — where Claude is involved — what you chose to delegate to it and what you kept for yourself. We are not grading polish. A rough repository with clear thinking beats a tidy one with none. We will not ask you to complete an unpaid take\-home assignment. Your existing work, plus a conversation about it, is enough.**How to Apply** ================ Send a resume, links to your repositories (or a note that your work is proprietary), and a short note about something you shipped and then had to support in the field: what broke, what you learned from the people using it, and what you changed as a result. That story tells us more than a stack list does. If invited to initial screening, we'll ask you to share a portfolio or a few examples of your work so we can get a better understanding of your experience and creative approach. **Equal Employment Opportunity** ================================ *We are an equal opportunity employer committed to building a team that reflects the customers we serve. We prohibit discrimination and harassment of any kind based on race, color, sex, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, veteran status, disability, genetic information, pregnancy, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local law. Reasonable accommodations are available at any stage of the hiring process — just ask.* Iw9E8gJI5Z

jobs.title: Founding Engineer, Applied AI
jobs.description: **About Parisi Labs** Parisi Labs is building foundational world models for physical industry. We are developing models that learn how complex physical systems behave and reuse that understanding across forecasts, scenarios, and operational decisions. Energy is our first proving ground. We combine historical and live data with operational context, bringing together machine learning research, data infrastructure, and software engineering to turn advances in modeling into useful technology for energy operators. We are a small technical team working directly with the founders on our core models, systems, and products. **About the role** We are looking for an engineer who can turn new modeling and agent ideas into working systems. You will build evaluations, data and inference workflows, backend services, internal tools, and product\-facing experiments while working directly with the founders and researchers. Your job is to shorten the path from hypothesis to reliable software and bring failures observed in real products and real data back into the next experiment. As the technology develops, you will help turn model outputs into useful forecasting, scenario\-exploration, and decision\-support capabilities. This is not a narrow ML infrastructure role, a pure research role, or a management job. You will own reusable technical capabilities, partnering with the data engineer on shared data foundations and the product engineer on the applications that expose those capabilities to users. **What you'll own** * Turn research and agent ideas into working prototypes, evaluations, internal tools, and customer\-ready capabilities. * Build reusable systems for forecasting, covariate search, model\-input preparation, inference, evaluation, and decision support. * Work across model code, APIs, data contracts, workflows, backend services, and lightweight product experiments. * Investigate failures in models, agents, and their surrounding systems, and turn findings into better evaluations and more dependable behavior. * Improve developer experience, observability, reliability, security, and deployment speed where they unlock more research and product progress. * Work with the CTO, Chief Scientist, and CEO on technical direction and the capabilities needed for customer deployments. * Help set the engineering standards for the team, including testing, technical documentation, and sound decisions about what to build or reuse. **What we're looking for** * A track record of taking ambiguous technical problems from an initial idea through implementation and reliable production use. * Strong software engineering skills across backend services, APIs, data workflows, testing, and debugging. * Hands\-on experience taking ML models or agent\-based systems into production, including evaluation, integration, failure analysis, and ongoing operation. * The ability to work in research and model code while also building maintainable services and developer tooling. * Technical judgment about when to experiment, when to invest in reusable infrastructure, and when a simpler solution is sufficient. * Clear communication and the ability to collaborate directly with researchers, product engineers, and founders. **First 90 days** * 30 days: Understand the modeling stack, data infrastructure, and how our technology is used in Ask The Grid; identify one high\-impact system to own. * 60 days: Ship a working capability that converts research, data, or customer learning into repeatable software. * 90 days: Own a durable technical capability and materially reduce repeated founder engineering work through reliable systems, tooling, or workflows. **Why join** You will help determine how the company's research becomes usable technology. The work spans experiments and production systems, with direct access to the people developing the models and the people using the resulting products. Your technical decisions will shape the engineering team we build around them. **Location and compensation** Location: New York City or Boston/Cambridge. This is a hybrid role — we expect in\-person collaboration 3 days per week in person. Salary range: $225,000–$280,000 USD.

jobs.title: Full-Stack Software Engineer
jobs.description: **Full\-Stack Software Engineer – Data \& Analytics** **Clinical Automation \& Platform Development** Company: Cole Neural Institute, Inc. Location: Coral Gables, Florida Work Arrangement: Full\-time; hybrid, with regular on\-site availability Reports To: Clinical Director/Founder and Executive Leadership Position Type: Permanent **About Cole Neural Institute** Cole Neural Institute (CNI) consolidates decades of proprietary neuroscience research in mental health treatment into the Cole Neurologic Method — a data\-informed approach combining EEG\-based neuroassessments, neurofeedback, cognitive coaching, psychometric assessments, and physiological data to help clients improve emotional and neurologic regulation. CNI is currently completing the automation of its clinical assessment, scoring, reporting, treatment\-planning, and outcomes\-tracking systems. Our long\-range objective is a complete "Clinic in a Box": a secure, scalable, plug\-and\-play technology and operating platform that will let qualified practitioners and clinics worldwide implement and deliver the Cole Neurologic Method consistently. We're seeking a permanent software engineer who can help us finish what we're building today and become a key technical leader in what it grows into tomorrow. **Position Summary** The Full\-Stack Software Engineer will take technical ownership of CNI's clinical automation systems and help transform the current system into a reliable, scalable, commercially deployable platform. Initial priority: understand, complete, test, document, and support the existing automation — including systems that collect and process psychometric surveys, EEG data, physiological information, client records, proprietary scoring algorithms, clinical summaries, treatment recommendations, and longitudinal outcomes. Longer\-term responsibility: help architect and build CNI's "Clinic in a Box" platform, including practitioner\-facing tools, clinical workflows, automated scoring engines, client management, reporting, integrations, data security, remote support, system monitoring, and multi\-clinic deployment. This is not a short\-term development assignment. Automation systems require continuous maintenance, refinement, quality control, and support. We're looking for someone who wants lasting ownership of a meaningful platform and wants to grow with the organization. **Primary Responsibilities** **Immediate Priorities** * Review and understand the existing codebase, automation workflows, technical documentation, databases, spreadsheets, integrations, and reporting systems * Complete and stabilize the automation currently under development * Translate CNI's proprietary clinical rules, formulas, thresholds, scoring models, and decision pathways into accurate, auditable software logic * Automate the ingestion, validation, scoring, and reporting of psychometric, EEG, physiological, wearable, and clinical data * Build safeguards to identify missing, inconsistent, incorrectly formatted, or clinically improbable data * Develop repeatable testing procedures for every scoring engine, formula, integration, and report * Troubleshoot production issues and provide dependable ongoing support * Document the system so its operation doesn't depend on undocumented knowledge held by one person * Work closely with CNI's founder, clinical team, neurotechnology staff, management, and outside development partners **Platform Development** * Help design and build the "Clinic in a Box" platform for independent practitioners and clinics * Develop practitioner dashboards, client records, assessment workflows, treatment\-planning tools, scoring summaries, progress reports, and administrative controls * Create a scalable, multi\-clinic architecture with appropriate separation of organizations, users, permissions, and client data * Design secure APIs and integrations with external platforms, wearable devices, EEG systems, survey systems, CRM platforms, cloud storage, and future CNI applications * Convert evolving clinical methodologies into configurable, version\-controlled rules engines * Ensure scoring results trace back to their source data, formula version, thresholds, and intermediate calculations * Develop deployment, monitoring, backup, error\-reporting, and recovery procedures * Support platform updates without disrupting active clinics or compromising historical results * Help create tools for practitioner onboarding, training, licensing, quality assurance, and remote support * Contribute to technical strategy, development priorities, vendor selection, and product planning **Data, Security, and Quality** * Process brainwave frequency data end\-to\-end, from ingestion to analytics, working with our neuroscientist and R\&D team * Apply privacy\-by\-design and security\-by\-design principles throughout the system * Help establish safeguards for sensitive health and personally identifiable information * Support HIPAA\-conscious architecture, access controls, audit lo tions, data pipelines, integrations, permissions, and user workflows * Maintain version control for formulas and scoring systems so historical assessments remain reproducible as methodologies evolve * Participate in formal validation of scoring results against clinician\-reviewed test cases **Required Qualifications** * Strong professional experience in full\-stack software development * Experience building and maintaining production applications — not only prototypes * Experience with AWS or a comparable cloud environment * Experience with Python/R, data analytics, automated scoring, or rules\-engine development * Strong knowledge of back\-end development, databases, APIs, integrations, and data\-processing workflows * Ability to understand complex rules and translate them into accurate, testable, maintainable software * Experience diagnosing and supporting systems after deployment * Understanding of software architecture, security, authentication, permissions, backups, logging, and monitoring * Experience with version control, code review, testing, deployment, and technical documentation * Ability to work directly with nontechnical subject\-matter experts and convert their methodology into clear technical requirements * Excellent attention to detail, particularly where small calculation or data\-mapping errors could materially affect results * Ability to take ownership, prioritize competing needs, and communicate risks and progress clearly * Willingness to work in a changing, entrepreneurial environment where the product and the organization are growing together **Preferred Qualifications** * Experience with healthcare, clinical technology, digital health, medical data, health\-tech SaaS, or regulated information * Familiarity with HIPAA, healthcare privacy, security controls, and auditability * Experience building multi\-tenant SaaS platforms * Experience integrating wearable devices, biosensors, EEG systems, or time\-series physiological data * Familiarity with AI\-assisted development and the responsible use of AI in clinical or data\-sensitive systems * Experience leading a platform from early\-stage development through production deployment and scale * Experience with signal processing * Interest in becoming a technical leader as the company grows **Why Join CNI?** This is an opportunity to become a foundational member of a company building a new kind of clinical technology platform. jobs.title: GPU Kernel Engineer
jobs.description: Sciforium is an AI infrastructure company developing next\-generation multimodal AI models and a proprietary, high\-efficiency serving platform. Backed by multi\-million\-dollar funding and direct sponsorship from AMD with hands\-on support from AMD engineers the team is scaling rapidly to build the full stack powering frontier AI models and real\-time applications. **About the role** ------------------ We are seeking a highly skilled GPU Kernel Engineer who is passionate about pushing the limits of performance on modern accelerators. In this role, you will design and optimize custom GPU kernels that power next\-generation large\-scale AI systems. You will work across the hardware–software stack, from low\-level kernel development to integrating optimized ops into high\-level ML frameworks used for large\-scale training and inference. This role is ideal for someone who thrives at the intersection of GPU programming, systems engineering, and cutting\-edge AI workloads, and who wants to make meaningful contributions to the efficiency and scalability of our ML platform. ### **Key Responsibilities** * Design, implement, and optimize custom GPU kernels using C\+\+, PTX, CUDA, ROCm, Triton, and/or JAX Pallas. * Profile and optimize end\-to\-end performance of ML operations, with a focus on large\-scale LLM training and inference. * Integrate low\-level GPU kernels into frameworks such as PyTorch, JAX, and custom internal runtimes. * Develop performance models, identify bottlenecks, and deliver kernel\-level improvements that significantly accelerate AI workloads. * Collaborate with ML researchers, distributed systems engineers, and model\-serving teams to optimize compute performance across the stack. * Work closely with hardware vendors (NVIDIA/AMD) and stay current on the latest GPU architecture capabilities and compiler/toolchain improvements. * Contribute to tooling, documentation, benchmarking suites, and testing frameworks to ensure correctness and performance reproducibility. ### **Must\-Haves** * 5\+ years of industry or research experience in GPU kernel development or high\-performance computing. * Bachelor’s, Master’s, or PhD in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Applied Mathematics, or a related field. * Strong programming skills in C\+\+, Python, and familiarity with ML frameworks. * Deep expertise in CUDA/ROCm, GPU memory models, and performance optimization strategies. * Hands\-on experience with Triton and/or JAX Pallas for custom kernel development. * Strong understanding of PTX, GPU ASM, and low\-level GPU execution. * Extensive experience writing and optimizing custom GPU kernels in C\+\+ and PTX. * Proven ability to integrate low\-level kernels into PyTorch, JAX, or similar frameworks. * Experience working with large\-scale LLM workloads (training or inference). ### **Nice\-to\-Haves** * Experience with AMD GPUs and ROCm optimization. * Familiarity with JAX FFI and custom ML operator development. * Experience with efficient model serving frameworks (e.g., vLLM, TensorRT). * Experience with TPUs, XLA, or similar accelerator programming environments. * Contributions to open\-source ML systems, compilers, or GPU kernels. **Benefits include** -------------------- * Medical, dental, and vision insurance * 401k plan * Daily lunch, snacks, and beverages * Flexible time off * Competitive salary and equity **Equal opportunity** --------------------- Sciforium is an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran or disability status. Compensation Range: $190K \- $250K

jobs.title: ML Data Platform Engineer
jobs.description: **About Parisi Labs** Parisi Labs is building foundational world models for physical industry. We are developing models that learn how complex physical systems behave and reuse that understanding across forecasts, scenarios, and operational decisions. Energy is our first proving ground. We combine historical and live data with operational context, bringing together machine learning research, data infrastructure, and software engineering to turn advances in modeling into useful technology for energy operators. We are a small technical team working directly with the founders on our core models, systems, and products. **About the role** We are looking for an ML Data Platform Engineer to make the data behind our models, products, and customer deployments dependable, understandable, and easy to use. This role sits where data engineering meets machine learning. You will turn messy, changing real\-world sources into durable datasets and interfaces that researchers and engineers can trust. Your work will support both public data and customer\-authorized operational data. The goal is not to build a large platform for its own sake. It is to make each new model, product capability, and data source faster to bring online without compromising correctness. You will own the shared data foundations, working with the applied\-AI engineer on model requirements and the product engineer on application needs. **What you'll own** * Build and improve ingestion, backfills, validation, and observability for high\-volume, time\-dependent data. * Define clear data contracts and point\-in\-time semantics for model training, evaluation, and product use. * Create reusable workflows for bringing public and customer\-authorized sources into the system. * Build quality, lineage, freshness, and access controls that make data trustworthy in repeated use. * Develop efficient datasets and query interfaces for machine\-learning and product workloads. * Diagnose whether failures originate in source data, transformations, model inputs, or serving systems. * Work with researchers and engineers to turn recurring data requirements into reliable software rather than manual projects. * Decide which abstractions should become shared infrastructure and which should remain purpose\-built. **What we're looking for** * A record of designing, building, and operating production data systems that researchers or engineers depend on. * Strong programming, querying, and data\-modeling skills, with the ability to write maintainable, tested production software. * An understanding of time\-dependent data correctness, including backfills, revisions, freshness, and point\-in\-time availability. * Experience supporting ML training and evaluation, or similarly demanding data\-intensive product workloads. * The ability to design practical data contracts, validation, observability, and access controls without overbuilding the platform. * Strong debugging and collaboration skills, including the ability to trace failures across systems and explain data limitations clearly. **First 90 days** * 30 days: Understand the data lifecycle behind Ask The Grid and our ML work, and identify the most consequential reliability and usability gaps. * 60 days: Ship a reusable ingestion, backfill, validation, or dataset capability used in active product or research work. * 90 days: Own a dependable end\-to\-end data workflow, with documented contracts, quality checks, and clear operational visibility. **Why join** The quality of our models and products depends on the quality of their underlying data. You will shape that foundation early, working directly with researchers and engineers who use it, and see your work support new experiments, product capabilities, and customer deployments. **Location and compensation** Location: New York City or Boston/Cambridge. This is a hybrid role — we expect in\-person collaboration 3 days per week in person. Salary range: $175,000–$245,000 USD.

jobs.title: Member of Technical Staff, Security
jobs.description: Mount Thor is hiring a security engineer to build and operate the systems that protect our infrastructure, customer workloads, and data. **Who We Are** -------------- Mount Thor makes Apple hardware (macOS and Apple Silicon) available and performant at datacenter scale for AI workloads. We take consumer hardware and build the infrastructure platform around it to enable consumption as elastic compute exposed through developer\-friendly interfaces. Our customers use us to develop computer\-use model capabilities, deploy long\-running agents, and accelerate agentic engineering. **The Role** ------------ You will own security engineering and the CI/CD systems that build, test, and deploy Mount Thor’s software. Your responsibilities span software delivery, infrastructure automation, customer data protection, and the engineering controls behind enterprise compliance. You will write code, implement controls, and work directly with engineers to secure the systems we build and operate. You will also own the technical work behind our SOC 2 Type 2 program and enterprise customer security requirements, from implementing controls to producing evidence that they work. You will work closely with Platform, Fleet, Network Infrastructure, and Operations, and represent our security architecture in conversations with customers and auditors. **In this role you will** ------------------------- * **Build security into our infrastructure and products.** Review designs, threat model systems, and implement protections across APIs, cloud environments, containers, host systems, and customer workload isolation. * **Own CI/CD and DevOps engineering.** Build and operate our build, test, and deployment pipelines, runners, artifact repositories, and infrastructure automation. Own environment provisioning, release workflows, deployment verification, and rollback. Improve delivery speed, reliability, and developer experience. Integrate security scanning, secrets management, artifact provenance, and access controls throughout these systems. * **Own identity, access, and secrets management.** Implement least privilege, service identity, privileged access, credential rotation, and access reviews across production and internal systems. Build access controls for both people and software agents. * **Protect customer data throughout its lifecycle.** Build controls for data collection, access, encryption, retention, deletion, and logging. Work with engineering and legal partners to translate privacy requirements and customer commitments into enforceable system behavior. * **Build and operate our SOC 2 Type 2 controls.** Translate requirements into engineering work, automate evidence collection and control checks, coordinate technical walkthroughs with auditors, and drive findings through remediation. Keep evidence connected to how production systems actually operate. * **Own the engineering response to enterprise security requirements.** Lead technical security reviews with customers, explain our architecture and controls, evaluate requirements, and deliver the changes needed to support customer adoption. Keep security documentation and customer commitments accurate. * **Build detection and response capabilities.** Establish useful security telemetry, investigate threats, lead security incidents, and turn findings into lasting improvements. Own vulnerability management and coordinate penetration testing and remediation. * **Use agentic engineering throughout the work.** Use coding agents to investigate, implement, and validate changes. Build tools that let agents inspect security posture, gather evidence, and perform bounded actions with appropriate authorization and auditability. **What you bring** ------------------ * Strong software engineering skills in Go, Python, Rust, or a similar language, with experience shipping and operating production software. * Hands\-on experience securing cloud infrastructure, APIs, containers, and distributed systems. * Experience owning production CI/CD systems and infrastructure as code, including diagnosing failed builds and deployments, managing environments, and improving release reliability. * Experience securing CI/CD pipelines, build infrastructure, deployment workflows, and software dependencies. * Depth in identity and authorization, secrets management, encryption, network security, and tenant isolation. * Experience implementing and operating controls for SOC 2 Type 2 or a comparable security assurance program. * Practical knowledge of privacy and data protection, including access controls, data minimization, retention, and deletion. * Experience investigating security incidents, prioritizing vulnerabilities, and delivering remediation. * The ability to explain technical systems clearly to engineers, customers, auditors, and leadership. * A record of taking broad, ambiguous security work from design through implementation and production operation. **Bonus Skills** ---------------- * Built a security engineering function at an early\-stage infrastructure or enterprise software company. * Secured multi\-tenant compute platforms, bare\-metal fleets, or customer\-managed workloads. * Worked with macOS, Apple Silicon, host security, secure boot, or hardware\-backed credentials. * Built compliance automation, policy\-as\-code, or continuous control monitoring. * Implemented workload identity, artifact signing, build provenance, or isolated build environments. * Supported enterprise requirements for data residency, customer\-managed encryption, or dedicated environments. * Built security controls for coding agents, computer\-use systems, or execution of untrusted code.

jobs.description: #### **Duties \& Responsibilities:** * Build a functional prototype of a mobile warehouse utility app designed to instantly count stacked warehouse supplies using ondevice artificial intelligence. * Train a lightweight, commercially viable custom object detection model (using frameworks like YOLOv8, YOLOv11, YOLONAS, or YOLOX) to recognize pallets, top frames, and layer pads across varying lighting conditions and angles. * Prepare and organize data by setting up a lightweight annotating workflow (e.g., Roboflow or CVAT) to label a dataset of 300500 images of inventory. * TensorFlow) and 1\+ years of experience working with the YOLO architecture. * Proven experience embedding machine learning models onto edge devices, with knowledge of leveraging hardware acceleration (Apple Neural Engine, GPU) highly preferred. * Proficiency in mobile frameworks (Dart/Flutter, JavaScript/React Native, Swift, or Kotlin). * Familiarity with data annotation, augmentation, and model #### **Compensation \& Hours:** Start Date: Available immediately. The engineer will identify vulnerabilities, validate findings, assess risk, provide remediation recommendations, and prepare a professional penetration testing report suitable for submission to government/municipal clients. **Responsibilities** * Perform penetration testing of web applications, REST APIs, mobile applications, and cloud infrastructure. * Test authentication, authorization, session management, access controls, APIs, and administrative interfaces. * Evaluate common vulnerabilities including OWASP Top 10 and API security risks. * Perform manual testing in addition to automated vulnerability scanning. * Verify vulnerabilities and minimize false positives. * Assign severity/risk ratings to findings. * Provide clear remediation recommendations to developers. * jobs.title: Rust Systems & Security Engineer
jobs.description: **Company**: Novavirt Inc. **Product:** BaseHV **Location:** Michigan only — remote/hybrid within Michigan, with periodic on\-site hardware/lab work in the Sterling Heights area **Employment:** Full\-time, W\-2 **Compensation:** $130,000–$145,000 annual base salary, depending on experience **Work authorization:** Must have legal authorization to work for Novavirt in the United States **Out\-of\-state remote work:** Not available. Candidates currently outside Michigan may apply but must relocate to Michigan before beginning employment. **About Novavirt and BaseHV** Novavirt is a Michigan\-headquartered enterprise infrastructure company developing cloud, managed\-services, and virtualization technology. BaseHV is Novavirt’s Rust\-based Type 1 bare\-metal hypervisor and virtualization\-management platform. The existing implementation already includes bare\-metal boot, Intel VT\-x/VMX initialization, Extended Page Table construction, an initial VM\-exit path, installer components, management APIs and CLI functionality, and the BHV\-FS datastore foundation. Novavirt is preparing a Phase I research program focused on determining whether BaseHV can progress from this technical foundation to secure guest execution with enforceable per\-VM memory isolation, constrained privileged unsafe\-code boundaries, predictable fault containment, and practical performance. We are seeking a Rust Systems \& Security Engineer to help rigorously test those claims rather than assume them. **The Role** The Rust Systems \& Security Engineer will work closely with the Principal Hypervisor Engineer / Principal Investigator to design, implement, and execute the security, correctness, fault\-injection, and performance\-validation portions of the BaseHV Phase I research program. This is not primarily an application\-security or web\-security role. The position focuses on privileged systems software: low\-level Rust, unsafe\-code boundaries, virtual\-memory isolation, hypervisor state transitions, adversarial guest behavior, resource exhaustion, failure containment, and reproducible systems experimentation. The engineer will help establish whether BaseHV’s memory\-safety\-oriented architecture actually provides measurable security and reliability benefits under controlled testing. If Phase I validates the architecture, this role is expected to continue as a foundational member of the BaseHV engineering organization as the platform expands into networking, storage, hardware compatibility, clustering, high availability, and production security. **Responsibilities** * Work with the Principal Hypervisor Engineer / PI to define measurable Phase I security, isolation, reliability, and performance criteria. * Identify and characterize unsafe Rust within security\-critical BaseHV components. * Help concentrate unavoidable unsafe operations behind narrow, documented, auditable interfaces. * Review low\-level code for memory\-safety hazards, incorrect assumptions, state corruption, and unsafe hardware interactions. * Develop tests for guest\-to\-host and VM\-to\-VM memory\-isolation boundaries. * Design adversarial guest workloads intended to exercise EPT violations, invalid accesses, malformed state transitions, and unexpected VM\-exit conditions. * Develop resource\-exhaustion tests involving CPU, memory, storage, and related constrained\-resource conditions. * Build fault\-injection test harnesses for crash recovery, lifecycle failures, invalid state transitions, and partial operations. * Validate VM create, boot, run, reset, stop, and failure\-state transitions. * Test whether faults affecting one workload remain contained from unrelated workloads and privileged BaseHV state. * Develop reproducible benchmarks for guest\-execution overhead, VM\-exit behavior, memory overhead, lifecycle timing, and recovery behavior. * Help define and measure the privileged unsafe\-code surface of BaseHV. * Document test methodology, expected invariants, observed failures, and research results suitable for NSF technical reporting. * Assist with Phase II planning for virtual\-network isolation, management security, expanded hardware support, and broader workload testing. * Participate in code review and help establish long\-term systems\-security engineering practices for the BaseHV team. **Required Qualifications** Strong candidates should demonstrate meaningful experience in several of the following areas: * Rust systems programming * Low\-level or performance\-sensitive software development * Memory safety and unsafe Rust * Operating\-system, kernel, hypervisor, firmware, embedded, or systems\-runtime development * Virtual memory, page tables, memory ownership, and protection boundaries * Systems security and isolation mechanisms * Fault injection, fuzzing, adversarial testing, or negative testing * State\-machine and lifecycle correctness testing * Concurrency, race\-condition analysis, and resource\-exhaustion behavior * QEMU, GDB, tracing, serial\-console debugging, or comparable low\-level diagnostic tools * Reproducible performance benchmarking and experimental methodology Experience with x86 virtualization, KVM, Xen, Firecracker, Cloud Hypervisor, QEMU, Linux kernel internals, or similar low\-level platforms is strongly preferred but not required if the candidate has deep Rust and systems\-security expertise. A Ph.D. is not required. Demonstrated systems\-engineering ability, careful security reasoning, and experience working close to hardware or privileged software are more important than a particular academic credential. **Preferred Experience** Additional valuable experience includes: * Intel VT\-x, VMCS, EPT, or AMD\-V/NPT * Security review of unsafe Rust * Fuzzing privileged or systems\-level software * Property\-based testing * Crash\-consistency or storage\-correctness testing * Security boundary modeling and threat modeling * Formal methods or model checking * Performance\-counter analysis * Hardware\-assisted virtualization testing * Open\-source systems software contributions **Research Responsibilities** The Phase I program will not treat the use of Rust as proof of security. The Rust Systems \& Security Engineer will help answer questions such as: * Which privileged operations still require unsafe Rust? * Can those operations be constrained to small and auditable interfaces? * Can one VM access memory owned by another VM? * Can a malformed or hostile guest corrupt privileged BaseHV state? * What happens when a VM exhausts memory or CPU resources? * Does BaseHV return to a defined state after injected failures? * Are test results reproducible across repeated executions? * What measurable performance cost results from the proposed safety architecture? The engineer will work with the PI to turn these questions into repeatable tests and quantitative Phase I success criteria. **Work Location** This position must be performed physically from Michigan. Novavirt may support remote or hybrid work within Michigan. Periodic access to physical BaseHV test infrastructure in the Sterling Heights area will be required for bare\-metal testing, failure injection, and hardware\-dependent validation. Candidates currently residing outside Michigan may apply if they are willing to establish their work location in Michigan before employment begins. Novavirt is not offering permanent out\-of\-state remote work for this position. **Why This Role Matters** BaseHV’s Phase I research is intended to determine whether a predominantly memory\-safe Rust hypervisor architecture can provide meaningful isolation and reliability advantages without unacceptable performance tradeoffs. The Rust Systems \& Security Engineer will be responsible for helping Novavirt prove—or disprove—those claims through rigorous testing. If the architecture succeeds, this engineer will have helped establish the security engineering practices, test methodology, and reliability standards that guide BaseHV as it develops from an R\&D platform into a production enterprise virtualization product. Pay: $130,000\.00 \- $145,000\.00 per year Benefits: * Dental insurance * Flexible schedule * Health insurance * Paid time off * Professional development assistance * Vision insurance People with a criminal record are encouraged to apply Work Location: Hybrid remote in Sterling Heights, MI 48313

jobs.title: Senior Technical Program Manager
jobs.description: Technology is at the heart of Disney’s past, present, and future. This requires experience communicating across audiences, effectively defining and utilizing escalation paths, and updating technology or business leaders. The program manager reports into the Global Program Management organization and will be responsible for driving delivery across the DEEP\&T. **Responsibilities:** --------------------- * **Project objectives, scale and scope of work, expected outcomes, business value and impact, timelines, roadmaps, resource level requirements + Establishes strong partnerships and engagement with project engagement with project stakeholders + Provides oversight to ensure critical day\-to\-day program/project deliverables progress forward to deliver specified requirements, objectives, and value + Identifies gaps in the project team’s accountability and ownership of deliverables + Foster a team environment of self\-organization, retrospect to learn and adapt with the goal of delivering the highest value to our guests and cast * **Financial Management** + Responsible for finance/budget responsibilities for projects and budgets (\<$1M). + Analyzes, measures and recognizes the financial impact of various project actions, participate in analyzing and using financial data to identify key project issues, and maintains budget tracking and monitors budget expenditures * **Status Reporting** + Prepares program/project status reports to demonstrate project overall health, key performance indicator (KPI), risk, issues, accomplishments, next steps, and escalation requests + Identifies and facilitates resolution of issues and risks on projects to meet commitments + Maintains data visualization elements to provide a graphic demonstration of project analytics and metrics * **Communication** + Leads with a win/win attitude with competing priorities and adapts to diverse personalities. Operates as an independent and dynamic project leader. and call to action updates across project teams + Demonstrates effective communication skills to facilitate project\-related conversations with technology senior leaders/managers/directors and service owners alike, and driving tasks and project dependencies to completion across multiple supporting teams + Escalates the need for guidance and support to direct manager effectively **Basic Qualifications:** ========================= * A minimum of 5\-years of applicable project management experience in a technology environment, preferably for a large company. * Proven experience with at least 5 years of experience in leading technology, multidisciplinary efforts across a large\-scale matrix organization * Experience in leading technology projects or multi\-threaded efforts * Able to Airtable, Smartsheets, etc. * End\-user experience in the use of modern program and project management tools, such as Smartsheet, Airtable, Jira/Confluence, etc. * Exposure to a wide range of productivity tools, including collaboration software (e.g., MS Teams), and standard MS Office tools (e.g., Outlook, PowerPoint, Excel, Word, OneDrive). * BA/BS in business, computer science preferred or other technical field or appropriate work experience **Preferred Qualifications:** ============================= * Prior Disney experience is preferred. jobs.title: Software Engineer
jobs.description: **About Como HR** Como HR is a third\-party fractional HR firm based in Los Angeles. We serve healthcare and behavioral healthcare organizations: behavioral health and SUD treatment providers, medical groups, occupational medicine, urgent care, surgical centers, home health, hospice, and dental practices. Our clients operate under layered compliance obligations. Federal rules, state rules, licensing bodies, and accrediting bodies all stack on top of each other, and every one of them attaches to a specific person, on a specific date, with a specific document. Most firms in our space run that on spreadsheets. We are building software instead. **About The Role** We are building the Como HR platform: the system our HR reps and our clients both live in every day. It tracks every employee at every client facility, resolves which documents each of them owes based on role, worker classification, state and facility, routes those documents out for signature, and escalates them before they expire. A working prototype already exists and covers most major surfaces. This role takes it from prototype to production system. You would be an early engineering hire. That means you get real ownership of real features very quickly, you sit close to the people who actually do the HR work, and you will see what you build get used within days rather than quarters. It also means the work is broad, the specs are sometimes a conversation rather than a ticket, and you need to be comfortable with that. **What You Will Work On** \- **The requirements engine.** Given a person, a role, a worker classification (1099 vs W\-2\), a state and a facility, determine what documents they owe and when. Effective\-dated, so a rule change does not silently rewrite history. \- **Template composition.** Federal core plus state pack plus facility packs, composed into a live requirement set, with edits at the template level propagating correctly to every account using it. \- **Two portals, one truth.** An internal rep\-facing portal and a client\-facing portal over the same data, with deliberate rules about what is mirrored and what is internal only. \- **Integrations.** DocuSign for document routing and status, Gmail for notifications, Google Calendar for deadlines and scheduling. \- **Reporting and compliance visibility.** Matrix views that stay usable at 100\+ employees against 60\+ document requirements per facility. \- **The boring, load\-bearing parts.** Data modeling, migrations, auth and permissions, audit trails, tests, and the harnesses that keep all of the above honest. **Our Stack** React on the front end. Python and Node.js in the tooling and validation layer today, with the production backend architecture still an open decision you would help make. Integrations against the DocuSign, Gmail and Google Calendar APIs. We are not dogmatic about frameworks and we do not expect you to have used ours. **What We Are Looking For** **Required** \- BS in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or equivalent practical experience. Recent graduates encouraged; this role is designed for someone at the start of their career. \- Solid fundamentals: data structures, relational data modeling, HTTP and REST, version control with Git. \- Working proficiency in at least one modern language (JavaScript/TypeScript, Python, Java, Go, C\#) and willingness to work in whichever the problem calls for. \- Enough front\-end capability to build and modify React components, whether from coursework, internships, or personal projects. \- Clear written communication. You will be writing specs and documentation, not just code. \- Genuine care about correctness. A missed expiration date in this system is a client's compliance failure, not a cosmetic bug. **AI fluency (required)** We build with AI\-assisted tooling as a default, not as a novelty. We are looking for someone who already works this way and can go further with it. \- Hands\-on experience with AI coding assistants such as Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, or similar, and good judgment about where they help and where they do not. \- Understanding of how LLMs actually work at a practical level: prompting, context windows, structured output, evaluation, and where hallucination risk lives. \- Interest in building AI features into the product itself. Document intake and classification, drafting, and intelligent compliance review are all on the roadmap. \- Bonus: exposure to Model Context Protocol (MCP), agent frameworks, RAG pipelines, or fine\-tuning. **Nice to have** \- Internship or project experience with multi\-tenant SaaS. \- Exposure to any regulated domain: healthcare, HR, finance, legal. \- Experience integrating third\-party APIs with real authentication and webhook handling. \- Anything you built and shipped that people other than your professor used. What we offer \- Direct mentorship from the principals, with no layers in between. \- Meaningful ownership of a core product from an early stage. \- A domain that is genuinely intricate. If you like systems where the rules are complicated and getting them right matters, this is that. \- *\[Benefits, PTO, equity or bonus structure to be added.]* **How To Apply** Tell us about one thing you built, what broke, and how you fixed it. If you have a GitHub, portfolio, or anything shipped and public, include it. We would rather see a small project you can explain deeply than a long list of technologies you have touched once. *Como HR is an equal opportunity employer. We consider all qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local law. Qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered in accordance with the California Fair Chance Act.* Pay: $100,000\.00 \- $140,000\.00 per year Application Question(s): * Tell us about one thing you built, what broke, and how you fixed it. If you have a GitHub, portfolio, or anything shipped and public, include it. We would rather see a small project you can explain deeply than a long list of technologies you have touched once. Work Location: Hybrid remote in Los Angeles, CA 90025

jobs.title: Sr. Five9 CCaaS Implementation Engineer
jobs.description: About Lion Mountain Lion Mountain is a professional services firm focused entirely on Five9 contact center implementations and migrations. We help mid\-market and enterprise customers move from legacy on\-premise systems and competing CCaaS platforms onto Five9, design the solution that actually fits their business, and stay with them through go\-live and beyond. We were Five9’s High Performance Demand Partner of 2025, and are on track to repeat for 2026\. We are a small, senior team that wins on depth, not volume. Our customers hire us because of our in\-depth Five9 knowledge, we treat their CRM and telephony stack like our own, and we do not hand work off to junior resources. Every engineer here owns customer outcomes end to end. The Role We are hiring an Implementation Engineer who can act as the lead Five9 solution architect on customer engagements. You will own implementations from discovery through go\-live: scoping the work, designing the call flows and integrations, configuring the Five9 environment, integrating it with the customer’s CRM, training their team, and standing behind it after launch. This is a customer\-facing, hands\-on role. You will be the technical expert in the room — the person the customer’s operations lead, IT lead, and CX leader all turn to. You will be backed by a small team of senior peers, with room to shape how we deliver as we grow. What You’ll DoLead Five9 implementations end to end * Run discovery workshops with customer business and technical stakeholders to capture current\-state contact center flows, pain points, and target outcomes. * Translate business requirements into a Five9 solution design — IVR / IVA flows, ACD and skills\-based routing, queues, dispositions, campaigns, reporting, WFM/WFO, and quality management. * Configure and deploy Five9: agent profiles, skills, campaigns, IVR scripts, prompts, DNIS / ANI mapping, dial plans, dispositions, supervisor and reporting setup. * Lead migration from legacy platforms (Genesys, NICE CXone, Avaya, Cisco, Twilio Flex, Amazon Connect, etc.) into Five9 with minimal disruption. * Own UAT, cutover planning, training, and go\-live and post go\-live support. Architect and build CRM integrations * Design and implement CRM integrations between Five9 and customer systems, including Salesforce, HubSpot, GoHighLevel, ServiceTitan, ImproveIt360, ServiceNow, etc.. and proprietary platforms. * Configure screen pop, click\-to\-dial, automated activity logging, and workflow triggers between Five9 and the CRM. * Where adapters are not enough, build custom integrations using the Five9 Agent API, REST/SOAP web services, VCC Agent Desktop Toolkit, and webhooks. * Partner with customer admins and developers to make the integration sustainable after we leave. Serve as the solution architect on each engagement * Own the technical design document and architecture diagrams for each project. * Make trade\-off decisions on routing strategy, IVR design, reporting model, security model, and integration approach — and clearly explain those trade\-offs to the customer. * Anticipate failure modes: telephony carrier handoffs, peak\-volume scaling, disaster recovery, security and compliance constraints (PCI, HIPAA, SOC 2\). * Quality\-check the build before it ever goes in front of the customer. Be the trusted technical voice with the customer * Lead status calls, design reviews, and executive readouts. * Translate fluently between contact center operations, IT, and executive leadership audiences. * Push back constructively when a customer ask will create long\-term pain — and bring an alternative. Make Lion Mountain better * Contribute to our implementation playbooks, reusable templates, and integration patterns. * Mentor peers on tricky Five9 features and integration approaches. * Share what you learn in the field so the whole team gets sharper with every engagement. What We’re Looking ForRequired * Hands\-on Five9 implementation experience. You have personally configured and deployed Five9 for production customers — not just observed or supported it. * Deep familiarity with core Five9 capabilities: IVR / IVA, ACD, campaigns (inbound, outbound, blended), skills\-based routing, Supervisor, reporting, WFA and APIs. * Working knowledge of Five9 Studio 7 / IVR scripting and the Five9 Agent Desktop Plus / VCC Agent. * Experience integrating Five9 with at least 2 major CRMs (Salesforce, HubSpot, GoHighLevel, ServiceTitan, ServiceNow, or similar) in production. * Strong understanding of contact center fundamentals: queueing, occupancy, AHT, SLAs, abandonment, blended outbound, compliance dialing (TCPA), call recording requirements. * Solid grasp of telephony concepts: SIP, DIDs, toll\-free, number porting, carrier handoffs, codecs, network requirements for VoIP quality. * Comfort with web technologies used in integrations: REST APIs, JSON, OAuth, webhooks, basic JavaScript. Reading and writing API calls is part of the job. * Excellent customer\-facing communication. You can run a workshop, write a design doc, and present to a VP — in the same week. * Self\-direction. You can own a project end to end without daily oversight. * US\-based and authorized to work in the US without sponsorship. Strongly preferred * Five9 Professional Services or Five9 Partner experience. * Five9 certifications (Implementation, Administrator, IVA, or specialty tracks). * Salesforce Service Cloud admin experience or Salesforce certification. * Experience migrating customers from Genesys, NICE CXone, Avaya, Cisco UCCE/UCCX, or Amazon Connect onto Five9\. * Experience with Five9 Intelligent Virtual Agent (IVA), Agent Assist, and AI / NLU concepts. * Experience in regulated industries: financial services, healthcare, insurance, or BPO. * Light scripting in Python or Node.js for integration glue. Pay: From $45\.00 per hour Expected hours: 30\.0 – 40\.0 per week Work Location: Remote

jobs.title: Founding Chief Technology Officer (CTO)
jobs.description: Founding Chief Technology Officer (CTO) **A.C.E. Platform \| Fully Remote \| Founding Executive Opportunity** Build the Technology Behind a Membership\-Powered Movement A.C.E. is seeking a **Founding Chief Technology Officer** to help take an already developing platform through launch, stabilization, growth, and ultimately scale. A.C.E. is: **Membership Powered.** **Impact Focused.** **Faith Rooted.** **Community Driven.** We are building a platform designed to bring people, ideas, resources, opportunities, businesses, organizations, and communities together in ways that create measurable growth and meaningful impact. A.C.E. is openly Christian in the values and principles behind the organization, but membership and employment are not limited by faith. We are intentionally building a welcoming platform for people from different backgrounds who believe in growth, opportunity, connection, purpose, and making a difference. This is not an idea sitting on a whiteboard. The A.C.E. website is functional. The membership platform has been established. Core systems including membership functionality, referrals, points and rewards have already been developed, and backend development is actively underway. Now we are looking for the person who can help take what has been built and get it fully across the finish line. THE IMMEDIATE MISSION The first responsibility of the Founding CTO is straightforward: **Get A.C.E. technically ready to launch, accept members, process activity reliably, and support growth.** At this stage, we need someone who is willing to be highly hands\-on. That means reviewing what already exists, identifying what remains unfinished, solving technical problems, improving systems where necessary, connecting pieces that need to work together, and helping make sure the platform is secure, stable and launch\-ready. As A.C.E. grows, this role is expected to evolve from hands\-on technical execution into full executive leadership of the company’s technology operations. WHAT YOU’LL OWN Responsibilities may include: · Reviewing the existing A.C.E. platform, website, backend architecture and supporting systems · Completing and improving launch\-critical development · Ensuring membership registration and account functionality operate properly · Managing and improving referral, points, rewards and engagement systems · Supporting payment processing and membership\-related integrations · Managing APIs, databases, hosting, cloud infrastructure and deployment · Troubleshooting technical issues and solving problems directly · Evaluating scalability, performance and reliability · Establishing security, privacy, backup and recovery standards · Identifying technical risks before they become business problems · Supporting development of future web and mobile applications · Creating a practical technology roadmap based on A.C.E.’s growth · Evaluating and selecting vendors, platforms and technical partners · Working directly with the Founder \& CEO on product development and priorities · Supporting analytics and data infrastructure as membership grows · Eventually recruiting and managing developers, engineers, contractors and technology partners · Building the technology department you will ultimately lead THE PERSON WE’RE LOOKING FOR We are not looking for someone whose primary goal is simply obtaining a C\-suite title. We need a **builder.** Someone who can look at an objective, assess what already exists, identify what is missing, and move the project forward. The ideal candidate is entrepreneurial, technically capable, resourceful, comfortable with ambiguity, and willing to work directly inside the technology before eventually leading others. Experience may include: · Full\-stack development · Web applications · Mobile applications · Backend systems · APIs and integrations · Databases · Cloud infrastructure · Membership or subscription platforms · Payment systems · Cybersecurity · SaaS or marketplace platforms · Startup or early\-stage technology environments You do not need to personally be the strongest engineer in every possible discipline. You do need enough technical depth to understand the systems, make sound decisions, diagnose problems, build where necessary, and know when specialized expertise should be brought in. FOUNDING EXECUTIVE COMPENSATION This is a **founding executive opportunity** designed for someone who wants to help build A.C.E. during its launch stage and grow into a long\-term C\-suite leadership position as the platform scales. A.C.E. is intentionally being built through **membership growth and internally generated revenue rather than outside investment.** Compensation for this role is designed to **increase progressively as defined launch, performance, membership, revenue and profitability milestones are achieved.** Rather than requiring the selected executive to wait until A.C.E. reaches full scale before compensation begins, the intention is to establish a **staged compensation structure** that allows earnings to begin incrementally as the company reaches agreed benchmarks. This creates a direct connection between execution, company growth and compensation. A strong candidate who helps move A.C.E. from development to launch quickly, stabilizes the platform, supports successful member acquisition and helps the company begin generating sustainable revenue may therefore reach paid compensation milestones sooner. Early\-stage compensation may begin through agreed milestone\-based payments, stipends, part\-time executive compensation or other structured compensation arrangements as A.C.E. begins producing revenue. As additional milestones are achieved and the company continues to grow, compensation may increase in stages until the role transitions into a fully compensated executive position. The target range for this role is annual base compensation in the **$100,000–$150,000\+ range**, based on responsibility, performance, company revenue, profitability and continued growth. The position remains flexible and results\-driven during the early stages. There is no requirement to immediately leave existing employment or maintain traditional corporate hours while A.C.E. is developing and generating its initial revenue. We care about one thing above all: **Getting the job done.** For the right founding executive, **performance\-based equity participation may also be negotiated.** Any equity would be limited, milestone\-based and subject to vesting requirements tied to meaningful contribution and continued involvement. Specific milestones, compensation stages, payment triggers and any equity opportunity will be clearly established with the selected candidate so there is a transparent path from the founding stage to full executive compensation. Simply put: **The faster A.C.E. reaches meaningful milestones, the sooner compensation can begin — and the faster the role can progress toward full executive compensation.** WHY THIS ROLE IS DIFFERENT You are not stepping into an established technology department. You have the opportunity to **build one.** The person who joins A.C.E. as Founding CTO will have significant influence over how the platform develops, how its infrastructure is built, how technology decisions are made, and what the future technology organization eventually becomes. The immediate objective is launch. The long\-term objective is scale. And the person who helps build that journey will have the opportunity to eventually lead it. TO APPLY Please submit a résumé, portfolio or LinkedIn profile along with a short introduction addressing: · What you have built, launched or scaled · Your strongest technical capabilities · Your experience taking products from development into production · How you approach inherited or partially completed technology · Why a founding\-stage opportunity interests you · What you believe your first 90 days with A.C.E. should accomplish **A.C.E. Platform** **Membership Powered. Impact Focused.** **Faith Rooted. Community Driven.** Pay: $100,000\.00 \- $150,000\.00 per year Benefits: * Flexible schedule * Paid time off People with a criminal record are encouraged to apply Work Location: Remote

jobs.title: Senior Applied AI Engineer
jobs.description: **About Abby Care: Powering the future of care at home for all of America.** ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- Abby Care is building the leading AI\-native platform for family\-led care. America is facing a growing care crisis. Millions more people need care at home than ever. Over 50 million family caregivers support loved ones without the tools, training, or recognition they deserve. We believe families are the largest untapped caregiving workforce in America, and that technology can help them deliver better care while driving stronger outcomes and greater transparency across the healthcare system. Abby Care combines clinical oversight with an AI\-powered platform to train, enable, and support family caregivers in delivering high\-quality care at home. Our platform helps health plans and government partners better understand, verify, and improve care in the home. We expand access to care, reduce reliance on higher\-cost settings, and help ensure public dollars are spent effectively. We are proud to partner with leading health plans, providers, and community organizations and are backed by top VCs. We envision a future where family\-led care is a core part of the healthcare system. Abby Care is building that future. **Join us in solving one of the most important challenges of our time.** **The Opportunity** ------------------- Abby Care is building an AI\-native operating system for home care—one that manages the full lifecycle from caregiver and patient intake through care delivery, billing, and compliance. As we expand our capacity to support more family caregivers at scale, we’re looking for a Senior Applied AI Engineer to design and build production AI systems that automate complex, consequential healthcare workflows. Reporting to the Applied AI Leader, you will own major initiatives from initial problem definition through production deployment and measurable impact. Depending on the problem, you may build an agent that collects clinical documentation, interprets evidence across multiple records, prepares a prior authorization packet, assists a nurse during a visit, identifies billing risk, or coordinates operational follow\-up. You will determine how workflows should be decomposed, what context and tools an AI system needs, how its behavior should be evaluated, where deterministic controls are required, and when a human must intervene. You will work closely with product engineers, product managers, designers, clinicians, operators, and analysts to ensure that the systems you build reflect real\-world workflows and produce meaningful outcomes. High\-agency and pragmatic, you are comfortable operating in ambiguity, moving between experimentation and production engineering, and owning technically complex systems end to end. If you are excited to apply frontier AI capabilities to difficult, high\-impact problems while transforming care in the home, we’d love to hear from you! This is a full\-time hybrid opportunity based in San Francisco, California, with four days per week in person. **What you’ll work on** ----------------------- * **Own high\-impact AI systems end to end:** Lead initiatives from workflow discovery and technical design through production deployment, iteration, and measurable business or care outcomes. * **Build reliable agents and copilots:** Develop systems that reason over structured and unstructured data, use internal tools, and execute multi\-step workflows across intake, care delivery, billing, and operations. * **Engineer for real\-world complexity:** Design systems that handle incomplete information, conflicting evidence, changing requirements, and operational edge cases by combining models, retrieval, rules, state machines, and human oversight. * **Build rigorous evaluation and monitoring:** Create representative datasets, evaluation harnesses, production tracing, confidence\-based escalation, and systematic error\-analysis processes. * **Integrate AI into complete workflows:** Partner with Product, Design, Clinical, Operations, Analytics, Platform, and System of Record engineers to ensure AI capabilities solve real problems rather than remain isolated prototypes. * **Raise the technical bar:** Contribute reusable platform capabilities, shape architectural decisions, mentor engineers, and improve how the team builds and operates Applied AI systems. **What success looks like** --------------------------- * You independently own and deliver complex Applied AI systems from discovery through sustained production operation. * The systems you build create measurable improvements in workflow completion, speed, quality, operational capacity, or family experience. * AI behavior is supported by representative evaluations, systematic error analysis, and clear production monitoring. * Your systems respond safely to uncertainty through confidence handling, escalation, and human approval where appropriate. * AI capabilities are integrated into end\-t or Applied AI experience. * Experience building and operating AI\- or machine\-learning\-powered systems in production. * Strong hands\-on experience with language models, retrieval systems, structured generation, model APIs, or agent architectures. * Strong software engineering fundamentals, including backend systems, APIs, data modeling, testing, and observability. * Experience designing evaluations and analyzing the behavior of probabilistic systems. * Demonstrated ability to take ownership of ambiguous, cross\-functional problems and drive them through implementation and iteration. * Strong judgment about where AI is appropriate and where deterministic approaches or human review are required. * Ability to communicate complex technical concepts clearly to technical and nontechnical partners. * Experience mentoring engineers, leading technically complex projects, or influencing architectural decisions. * Must reside in or be willing to permanently relocate to the San Francisco Bay Area. * Experience with model fine\-tuning, post\-training, reinforcement learning, synthetic data generation, multimodal models, document intelligence, knowledge graphs, ontologies, workflow engines, or state machines is preferred but not required. * Experience in healthcare, fintech, insurance, or another regulated and operations\-intensive environment is preferred but not required. **Benefits** * **Competitive compensation packages** that reflect the value you bring. We reward our team for the impact of their work. * **Comprehensive health coverage that works for you.** Choose from high\-quality medical dental and vision options, including a $0 deductible PPO and a company\-funded HSA, alongside employer\-paid life and disability insurance. * **Generous paid time off.** We provide policies that allow you to recharge along with 10 paid company holidays. * **Financial savings benefits to support your future.** We support your financial well\-being with HSA contributions, optional FSA and commuter benefits, and full coverage of all 401(k) account fees (employer match not currently offered). * **Paid parental leave to support your growing family.** We provide paid leave, so you can focus on bonding and adjusting to life as your family grows. **Our Values** -------------- * **Families First** Redefining healthcare starts with how we treat the parents and children we serve. We go above and beyond for every family, building strong, lasting relationships. We continually ask ourselves, *“Would we want this for our own families?”* * **Urgency with Precision** Millions of families are waiting for care, and they cannot wait, therefore this is not your typical 9 to 5 job. We match their urgency with our own, delivering exceptional care without compromise. Here, speed and excellence go hand in hand**.** * **Relentlessly Resourceful** As an ambitious startup, we adapt quickly and make the most of limited time and resources. We solve challenges with creativity to deliver results without unnecessary complexity. * **Purpose with Positivity** We take our mission seriously while never losing sight of the people behind the work. Respect, kindness, memes, and coffee make us stronger as a team and better for the families we serve. * **Driven to Redefine What’s Possible** We are here to make healthcare better, which means asking hard questions, challenging outdated systems, and finding smarter, more compassionate ways to deliver care. ***Automated Decision Tools*** *Abby Care may use automated decision tools to help match and rank candidate work experience, education and skills found in online profiles, resumes and job applications against job requirements. We believe that these tools help ensure objective, data\-based decisions during the hiring process, however, all Abby Care hiring decisions involve final human review and input. If you have questions or would like to request an alternative process, contact* *talent@abbycare.org**.* Compensation Range: $220K \- $270K

jobs.description: Tempe, AZ * Hybrid 09/11/2026 * Full\-time REF3679V **Job Description** ------------------- We are seeking an **Associate AI Solutions Engineer** for our Technology team with a developing skill set across applied AI engineering, large language model integration, and enterprise software development. In this role, you will support the design, build, and deployment of AI\-powered solutions that drive measurable business outcomes across our organization. You will collaborate with senior engineers and cross\-functional teams to deliver intelligent systems that improve how we serve our members and how our teams operate. **Primary Responsibilities and Duties** This role will help design, build, and document AI solutions and collaborate amongst Technology and business groups to support internal teams and advance Achieve's AI strategy. * AI Solution Development: Build AI\-powered applications, agents, and workflows under the guidance of senior engineers to automate manual work and create new capabilities. Contribute to integrating AI responsibly into production systems and existing platforms. * LLM and Agent Implementation: Develop solutions using large language models, retrieval\-augmented generation (RAG), and agentic frameworks. Contribute to shared infrastructure including prompt libraries, evaluation harnesses, and Model Context Protocol (MCP) integrations. * Enterprise Integration: Help implement integration patterns that connect AI solutions to enterprise systems (CRMs, data warehouses, ticketing platforms, financial systems).
