jobs.title: JUNIOR AI AUTOMATION & SYSTEMS DEVELOPER
jobs.description: **Company Overview** Project Support Services is a dynamic, woman\-owned, disadvantaged business enterprise, and small business enterprise specializing in project management within the realm of Division of State Architecture (DSA) compliance. We collaborate closely with districts, architects, engineers, and other stakeholders to resolve complex issues, close outdated projects, manage ongoing initiatives, and ensure adherence to DSA regulations. Our expertise and strong relationships with DSA staff have helped numerous school districts successfully close projects once deemed impossible. **Job Overview** We are seeking an energetic and motivated Junior AI Automation \& Systems Developer to join our innovative team. In this role, you will support the development and automation of systems that enhance project management workflows and compliance processes. You will work closely with senior developers and engineers to design scalable solutions using modern programming languages and cloud infrastructure. This position offers an exciting opportunity to grow your skills in software engineering, AI automation, and system design within a collaborative environment committed to excellence. BUILD REAL AI SOLUTIONS FOR A GROWING COMPANY Are you the person everyone asks about AI, automation, computers, and new technology? Have you already built custom GPTs, AI agents, automated workflows, integrations, websites, dashboards, or other technology solutions? Project Support Services, Inc. (PSS) is looking for a talented and resourceful AI Automation \& Systems Developer to help us streamline and modernize our business. This is a hands\-on building position. You will work directly with company leadership and our departments to understand how work is currently completed, identify opportunities for improvement, and develop AI agents, prompts, automations, and internal tools that our employees will actually use. This opportunity is open to current college students, recent graduates, early\-career professionals, and self\-taught developers. A college degree is not required. We care more about what you can build, how you solve problems, and whether you can turn an idea into a reliable working solution. THIS IS NOT A BEGINNER AI INTERNSHIP PSS will teach you about our company, departments, clients, and business processes. However, we are not looking for someone who has only used ChatGPT to ask basic questions. You must already know how to build AI agents, engineer prompts, create automations, work with data, connect systems, test your work, and protect confidential information. WHAT YOU WILL DO * Meet with company leadership and employees to understand their daily processes and challenges. * Map existing business processes and identify repetitive, inefficient, or manual tasks. * Build custom GPTs, AI agents, and department\-specific AI assistants. * Write, test, organize, and improve prompts and system instructions. * Create prompt libraries and reusable AI workflows. * Build agents that review documents, analyze information, prepare reports, and produce structured results. * Develop automated workflows using Zapier, Make, Power Automate, n8n, or comparable platforms. * Connect AI tools with company systems using APIs and other integrations. * Create workflows that extract, classify, summarize, and analyze information from PDFs and other business documents. * Work with spreadsheets, databases, dashboards, and data\-visualization tools. * Build or support internal applications, websites, dashboards, and business tools. * Test AI\-generated results for accuracy, consistency, reliability, and usefulness. * Establish human\-review and quality\-control steps for AI workflows. * Troubleshoot technology, automation, and integration issues. * Research new AI tools and recommend practical applications for PSS. * Document completed tools and create clear instructions for employees. * Train employees to use approved AI tools and workflows. * Help PSS establish responsible AI, cybersecurity, and data\-privacy practices. * Maintain the confidentiality of company, employee, client, and project information. EXAMPLES OF PROJECTS YOU MAY BUILD * An AI agent that reviews project reports and calculates completion percentages. * An agent that reads a program\-level PDF and produces results for every project. * Department\-specific AI assistants for Operations, Recruiting, Accounting, Marketing, and Executive Leadership. * Automated reports and notifications based on project information. * AI workflows that extract information from PDFs and enter it into structured reports. * Prompt systems that produce accurate and repeatable business documents. * Automations that reduce manual data entry and repetitive administrative work. * Internal dashboards that display project, staffing, financial, or operational information. * A searchable company knowledge system that helps employees find information quickly. * Integrations between AI tools and Microsoft 365, Sh  levels of technical knowledge. * Welcome feedback and can revise your work until it meets the company’s needs. * Understand the importance of protecting confidential business and client information. * Want your work to make an immediate and measurable impact. * Can work consistently from our Corona office. PORTFOLIO REQUIRED Applicants must submit at least two examples of completed work, such as: * A custom AI agent or GPT. * An automated business workflow. * A prompt system that produces structured and repeatable results. * An API or software integration. * An AI document\-processing workflow. * A dashboard, website, application, or internal tool. * A school, personal, freelance, or professional project demonstrating comparable technical ability. For each example, please explain: * What problem the project solved. * Which tools and platforms you used. * What portion of the project you personally built. * How you tested the solution. * How the completed project saved time, reduced manual work, or improved results. School projects, personal projects, and independently developed tools are welcome. The work does not need to have been completed for an employer. PRACTICAL SKILLS ASSESSMENT Final candidates will be invited to complete a practical, paid skills assessment. The assessment may ask you to review a sample PSS business process and demonstrate how you would: * Map the current workflow. * Identify opportunities for AI and automation. * Build or outline an AI agent. * Write the necessary system instructions and prompts. * Explain how the agent would connect with company systems. * Test the accuracy and reliability of its results. * Establish appropriate human\-review requirements. * Protect confidential company and client information. WHAT YOU WILL GAIN * Hands\-on experience implementing AI throughout a growing company. * The opportunity to build tools that employees will use in real business operations. * Direct access to executive leadership and department decision\-makers. * Exposure to construction consulting, public agencies, government contracting, recruiting, accounting, marketing, and project management. * Projects and measurable results you can add to your professional portfolio. * The opportunity to help shape PSS’s long\-term AI and technology strategy. * Potential consideration for a permanent full\-time role based on performance and company needs. ABOUT PROJECT SUPPORT SERVICES Project Support Services, Inc. is a woman\-owned construction and professional\-services firm headquartered in Corona, California. PSS supports public agencies through DSA compliance and certification services, staff augmentation, construction services, and federal contracting. As PSS continues to grow, we are investing in artificial intelligence, automation, and technology to improve efficiency, accuracy, communication, and consistency. We are looking for someone who is excited to help us build the systems that will support the company’s next stage of growth. HOW TO APPLY Please submit the following: * Your résumé or a summary of your education and experience. * A brief explanation of how you currently use AI and automation. * At least two examples of AI, automation, programming, integration, website, dashboard, or technology projects you have built. * Links, screenshots, videos, or other materials demonstrating your work. * A brief response to the following question: “If you joined a company where employees spend hours reviewing PDFs and manually preparing reports, how would you evaluate the process and determine what should be automated?” Applications that do not include examples of completed work may not be considered. Project Support Services, Inc. is an equal opportunity employer. Employment decisions are based on qualifications, demonstrated skills, merit, business needs, and the ability to perform the responsibilities of the position. Pay: $20\.00 \- $30\.00 per hour Expected hours: 20\.0 – 30\.0 per week Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Product Manager, Data & Analytics
jobs.description: **About Removery** Join us at Removery \- the global leader in laser tattoo removal. We aim to normalize tattoo removal and empower people to feel comfortable in their skin. We provide the highest quality of service and care at every stage of our clients’ removal or fading journeys. Removery was formed in 2019 through a merge of the four leading tattoo removal brands. Now, with more than 150 studios located in the United States, Canada, and Australia, and over 2 million successful treatments to date – we’ve raised the standard for the entire industry. Using best\-in\-class innovative PicoWay® laser technology, we ensure safe and effective tattoo removal. The foundation is in place continue growing globally, as we are committed to making tattoo removal safe and accessible to as many people as we can. **Position Overview** We are seeking a **Product Manager, Data \& Analytics** to treat internal reporting and analytics as a product with real customers: operations, marketing, finance, and the leadership team. A substantial Power BI footprint carries that weight today, and it has taken us a long way — but the next stage of our growth deserves a deliberate decision about what our analytics platform should become, and that decision has not been made yet. You will keep the current stack healthy and trusted while you build the case for what comes next — and then you will lead the execution, not hand off a slide deck. You will also stand up real product and customer\-journey analytics, partnering with Engineering to instrument our digital products so we can answer funnel, retention, and behavior questions without a data engineering ticket every time. If you want clean greenfield, this is not it. If you want to own the decision that sets how a whole company measures itself, it is. You will lead a dedicated, long\-tenured nearshore pod of engineers and analysts rather than a rotating bench \- real leadership without a large org chart, where your judgment is spent on the product and the people who depend on it. **Key Responsibilities** Own the Current Power BI Stack * Own the existing reporting portfolio end to end: what exists, who uses it, what it costs, what it is trusted for, and where it has drifted. * Take control of the request queue. Establish intake, prioritization, and — critically — a sunset process for reports that are not earning their keep. * Own the reliability basics: refresh health, data freshness expectations, workspace and access hygiene, and clear metric definitions people can point to. * Keep stakeholders confident through a transition. Nothing about a future migration excuses today's numbers being late or wrong. Define the Vision for What Comes Next * Lead the evaluation: BI and semantic layer, warehouse and modeling approach, product analytics, embedded or customer\-facing reporting, and where AI\-assisted querying genuinely helps versus where it is a demo. * Build the recommendation — architecture, vendors, cost, migration path, risks, and what we stop doing — and get it approved. * Define the metric layer that outlives any tool choice: canonical definitions, named owners, and a source of truth people trust more than their own spreadsheet. Product Analytics and Instrumentation * Stand up real product and customer\-journey analytics. Design the event taxonomy and tracking plan, then hold the line on it as new surfaces ship. * Partner with Engineering to instrument our digital products so we can answer funnel, retention, and behavior questions without a data engineering ticket every time. Execution * Run the roadmap: discovery with real users, written specs, prioritization you can defend, and delivery in increments that ship value along the way. * Work directly with data engineering, analysts, and application engineers as a partner who writes clear requirements and makes tradeoffs — not a ticket router. * Manage the migration as a program: sequencing, parallel\-run periods, validation, cutover, decommissioning, and change management for the many people whose daily habits you are changing. * Report on your own impact: adoption, time\-to\-answer, decisions enabled, and cost per report — not dashboards delivered. **Position Requirements:** * Ability to work in office 4\+ days a week, in Austin, TX. * 5\+ years in product management, analytics product management, or analytics and BI leadership where you owned outcomes rather than a queue. * Hands\-on depth with Power BI: semantic models, DAX, workspaces, gateways, and capacity — enough to audit what we have and diagnose what it needs without needing a translator. * SQL you actually use. You can validate a number yourself before you defend it in a meeting. * Experience leading a platform evaluation or replacement with real money and real stakeholders attached, and then living with the result. * Fluency in modern data architecture: warehouses and lakehouses (Fabric, Snowflake, BigQuery, Databricks), transformation (dbt or equivalent), ingestion, and semantic layers. * Genuine stakeholder skill. You can tell a VP that their favorite report is going away and have them agree with you. * Excellent written communication. You write the document before you build the thing. * Experience working day to day with distributed or nearshore delivery teams. You write requirements that survive a time\-zone gap, and you hold quality without hovering. * Comfort with ambiguity and a bias toward shipping something useful this quarter. **Preferred Experience:** * Product analytics experience — Mixpanel, Amplitude, PostHog, or similar — is a significant plus. Event\-based analytics, funnels, cohorts, and retention analysis in a tool built for behavior, rather than a BI tool bent into the shape of one. * Microsoft Fabric experience, or a clear\-eyed view of when it is the right answer and when it is not. * Multi\-site retail, healthcare, or consumer services background. Operational reporting for field teams is its own discipline. * Experience with marketing and attribution data, CRM or contact\-center data, or revenue and finance reporting. * Experience shipping AI or LLM\-assisted analytics features that people actually used. * Data governance or privacy experience in a regulated environment. **You will be part of a supportive and close\-knit team and given the opportunity to perform purposeful work. Removery is proud to offer a competitive salary, based upon experience, in tandem with a competitive benefits package for FT associates including:** * Comprehensive Medical, Dental, and Vision with HRA option, STD and LTD * 50K in Life Insurance, at no cost to you! Plus, the option to purchase more. * Flexible Paid Time Off * Paid Parental Leave * Eight (8\) company paid holidays * 8 hours of paid volunteer time per year * 401K with generous Company Match * Team Member Referral Bonus Program * Employee Assistance Program * Collaborative work environment with an amazing culture committed to diversity and inclusion. To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. Other duties may be assigned. We are deeply committed to attracting talented team members from all backgrounds regardless of race, age, gender, ethnicity, religion, sexual orientation, disability status, or nationality. However, currently, we are not sponsoring any Visas. jobs.title: Senior System Administrator
jobs.description: **About Radiant** ----------------- Radiant is an El Segundo, CA\-based startup building the world’s first mass\-produced, portable nuclear microreactors. The company’s first reactor, Kaleidos, is a 1\-megawatt, fail\-safe microreactor that can be transported anywhere power is needed and run for up to 5 years without refueling. Portable nuclear power with rapid\-deploy capability can replace similar\-sized diesel generators and provide critical asset support for hospitals, data centers, remote sites, and military bases. Radiant’s unique, practical approach to nuclear development leverages modern software engineering to rapidly deliver safe, factory\-built microreactors that use existing, well\-qualified materials. Founded in 2020, Radiant is on track to test its first reactor at the Idaho National Laboratory this summer, with initial customer deliveries beginning in 2028\. **About the Role:** ------------------- Radiant is seeking a Senior Systems Administrator to own the systems that keep the company running day\-to\-day within Microsoft 365 GCC High. You'll own the tenant, build our identity and access automation from the ground up in an Entra\-native environment with no on\-prem Active Directory or Group Policy, and manage the endpoint, email security, and SaaS infrastructure the business runs on. You'll implement and evidence the technical controls behind our CMMC assessment as part of the normal job, not a detour. jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, Backend - Data Cloud
jobs.description: **About Rippling** ------------------ Rippling gives businesses one place to run HR, IT, and Finance. It brings together all of the workforce systems that are normally scattered across a company, like payroll, expenses, benefits, and computers. For the first time ever, you can manage and automate every part of the employee lifecycle in a single system. Take onboarding, for example. With Rippling, you can hire a new employee anywhere in the world and set up their payroll, corporate card, computer, benefits, and even third\-party apps like Slack and Microsoft 365—all within 90 seconds. Based in San Francisco, CA, Rippling has raised $1\.4B\+ from the world’s top investors—including Kleiner Perkins, Founders Fund, Sequoia, Greenoaks, and Bedrock—and was named one of America's best startup employers by Forbes. We prioritize candidate safety. Please be aware that all official communication will only be sent from @Rippling.com addresses. **About the Data Cloud Team** ----------------------------- Rippling Data Cloud is a new suite of products that aggregates data from across your company into Rippling, connects it to worker identity, and makes it available for analysis, visualization and action. It preserves and enriches data context to enable precise and accurate answers to your most important and nuanced business questions. It's a complete data stack including data connectors, transformations, visualizations, AI\-powered analytics, and even inbound Zero\-Copy. It understands how all of that data relates to employees, managers, departments, locations, cost centers, permissions, and historical changes in your ever\-changing business. That makes it possible to ask questions that traditional BI systems struggle to answer correctly. **Data Cloud as the foundation for Rippling AI** ------------------------------------------------ Data Cloud and AI are deeply connected in Rippling. Data Cloud is the data infrastructure layer that powers Rippling AI. Here's how they relate: **Data Cloud provides the unified data that AI reasons over:** Rippling AI leverages the Employee Graph and all platform data (payroll rules, earnings types, deduction logic, permissions, etc.) as its source of truthBecause Rippling is a unified platform rather than stitched\-together acquisitions, the data is clean, consistent, and complete which makes AI answers accurate and context\-awareAI respects the same permissions model as the rest of the platform, so it only surfaces data the user is authorized to see **The Rippling AI unlocks advanced Data Cloud capabilities:** * AI Dashboards: build dashboards from scratch using natural language prompts * Transformations: full publish access * Pipelines: ingest data via managed connectors * Lineage \& Catalog: explore data lineage for reports * Advanced features: parameters, SQL queries, and the ability to incorporate third\-party data **Why this matters** Most HR/Finance systems weren't built for AI. Their data is messy and fragmented. Rippling AI is described as the first "context\-aware, senior analyst" for HR and Finance teams because it sits on top of a unified data model (Data Cloud \+ Employee Graph) that actually understands your business logic end\-to\-end. **What We Build** ----------------- The team is focused on the following core domains: * **Analytics** – Focuses on the reporting and dashboarding products that enable users to visualize and analyze data within Rippling. * **Data Access** – Owns the query engine (RQL, Rippling Query Language) that powers data retrieval across the platform. This area includes sub\-teams responsible for query execution, data ingestion, and query history. * **Data Management** – Owns the metadata and data catalog layer, including how data assets are discovered, governed, and documented. * **Ingest \& Prep** – Responsible for bringing external data into Rippling. This area includes Managed Connectors (pre\-built integrations with third\-party systems) and Transformations (data shaping and preparation). * **Insights** – A newer area within Data Cloud focused on surfacing actionable insights from data. **What You'll Do** ------------------ * Work on distributed processing engines and distributed databases * Develop high\-quality software with attention to detail using tech stacks like Python, MongoDB, CDC, and Kafka * Leverage big data technologies like Aurora, Trino, Presto, Pinot, Iceberg, Flink and more. * Build custom programming languages within the Rippling Platform * Create data platforms, data lakes, and data ingestion systems that work at scale * Design, develop, code, and test software systems, improvements, products, and user\-facing experiences * Work alongside software architects and senior developers doing state\-of\-the\-art development work * Contribute to product design and implementation discussions * Find and build unique solutions to implement projects from the idea phase to production **What You'll Need** -------------------- * 6\+ years experience in backend engineering roles * Experience writing testable and performant backend code * Experience working in a fast\-paced, dynamic environment * Experience mentoring less\-experienced developers * Ability to thrive in an environment that grants you a lot of autonomy to explore creative solutions **Additional Information** -------------------------- Rippling is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workforce and do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, ancestry, physical disability, mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, marital status, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, age, sexual orientation, veteran or military status, or any other legally protected characteristics, Rippling is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for candidates with disabilities who need assistance during the hiring process. To request a reasonable accommodation, please email accomodations@rippling.com Rippling highly values having employees working in\-office to foster a collaborative work environment and company culture. For office\-based employees (employees who live within a defined radius of a Rippling office), Rippling considers working in the office, at least three days a week under current policy, to be an essential function of the employee's role. This role will receive a competitive salary \+ benefits \+ equity. The salary for US\-based employees will be aligned with one of the ranges below based on location; see which tier applies to your location here. A variety of factors are considered when determining someone’s compensation–including a candidate’s professional background, experience, and location. Final offer amounts may vary from the amounts listed below. **The pay range for this role is:** 168,000 \- 280,000 USD per year(US San Francisco Bay Area) 168,000 \- 280,000 USD per year(US Tier 1\)

jobs.title: Automation Engineer
jobs.description: **Who We Are** ============== Serval is an AI\-native automation platform transforming how enterprises operate. We build intelligent agents that understand real\-world workflows and execute them end\-to\-end — replacing manual processes and rigid legacy systems with adaptive, learning software. Founded in early 2024, Serval is already trusted by companies like Fox, Notion, Perplexity, Vercel, and Brex to automate high\-volume, high\-friction operational work across their organizations. At the core of Serval is an agentic AI platform that turns natural language into production\-grade workflows. Our agents don’t just respond to requests — they reason, take action across systems, and continuously improve with usage. What began with operational use cases has quickly evolved into a horizontal AI automation layer used across IT, HR, Finance, Security, Legal, and Engineering. Our mission is to eliminate repetitive, manual work across the enterprise and give teams leverage through intelligent automation. Long term, we’re building the universal AI operations layer — a system of agents that sits across business functions and runs the workflows that keep modern companies moving. We’re backed by leading investors including Sequoia Capital, Redpoint Ventures, Meritech, First Round, General Catalyst, Elad Gil, and others. **Role Overview** ================= With Serval, an automation that used to take a SOW and a quarter now takes a sentence and an afternoon. That one change is why Automation Engineering is becoming the operating model for enterprise services, and why service teams stop being a bottleneck and start being an advantage. As an Automation Engineer, you build Serval's agents directly into the customer's instance, and the tickets stop arriving: onboarding, access requests, approvals, the long tail that clogs a service desk. You'll push Serval past its current limits into new use cases, dogfood unreleased features, bring field ideas back to our product team, and act as a practitioner evangelist for both Serval and Automation Engineering. This is a title we are coining. Nobody has ten years of it yet, so what you build becomes the standard for everyone after you. **What You’ll Do** ================== * **Build in the platform:** design and build automations and AI agents inside customers' Serval instances, from onboarding and access requests to the long tail that clogs a service desk. * **Wire up the stack:** integrate Serval with customer systems (Okta, Google Workspace, Slack, Jira, ServiceNow, Workday) so automations complete end to end. * **Run working sessions:** embed with IT, HR, Finance, and Legal teams, pull the real process out of them, and turn it into something buildable the same day. * **Enable customer builders:** turn what you build into reusable patterns and teach customers' own teams to extend them, so adoption compounds after you leave. * **Partner with Deployment:** work alongside Deployment Strategists to hit the milestones a customer signed up for, and surface risk early when a use case is going sideways. **What You’ll Need** ==================== * Degree in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent hands\-on experience. * 2\+ years in a relevant role (IT or service operations, professional services, solutions engineering, business systems, technical support). * Working knowledge of APIs and REST, JSON, and IAM concepts including SSO, SCIM, and provisioning. * Strong communication skills, with the ability to run a working session, challenge a requirement, and translate technical tradeoffs for non\-technical stakeholders. * Ability to learn unfamiliar software quickly and work independently across several customer accounts. **Nice to Have** ================ * Experience in an early\-stage startup environment. * Hands\-on time administering or migrating an ITSM platform (ServiceNow, Jira Service Management, Freshservice, Zendesk). * Familiarity with IT, security, service management, or workflow automation. **What We Offer** ----------------- * **Impact**: Be a key player in shaping the success of our product and company. * **Growth**: Build a fundamentally new AI product offering with the support of our experienced team and investors. Grow rapidly with the company. * **Culture**: Join a culture that values innovation, ownership, accountability, and fun. Compensation Range: $105K \- $220K

jobs.title: Quality Assurance Engineer
jobs.description: STAR Autism Support has an opening for Quality Assurance Engineer! STAR Autism Support (SAS) is a family\-founded educational consulting company based in Portland, OR. SAS provides curriculum materials, workshops and training to school and agency staff who work with students with autism and other developmental disabilities. Our unique and practical approach provides school districts with curriculum resources and a continuum of professional development activities to address the educational needs of student’s early childhood through post\-secondary throughout the country and internationally. At SAS our goal is to cultivate a supportive, positive and welcoming work environment where all staff can successfully thrive. We value and celebrate equity, diversity, and inclusion. Our vision of equity includes a continuous commitment to becoming an antiracist, multicultural organization. We strive to provide all employees with a culture of curiosity and continued learning. **Position Summary/Objective** Star Autism Support builds curriculum, training, and software for educators teaching students with autism and developmental disabilities. Our software gets used in classrooms by teachers and paraprofessionals who have a few minutes between activities. A confusing screen or a slow data page costs them time with a student. This is our first dedicated QA hire. You will build our automated test coverage from the ground up, run usability and performance testing, and set the quality practices the product development team works to. That means choosing tooling and standards yourself, and working embedded with the team rather than as a gate at the end. **Essential Functions and Responsibilities** Functional testing and automation * Build and own automated regression suites for our web apps and APIs, wired into CI. * Decide what belongs in unit, integration, contract, and end\-to\-end tests, and push coverage to the cheapest layer that catches the problem. * Write test code other engineers can read and extend. Fix or delete flaky tests rather than retrying them. * Run exploratory and risk\-based manual testing where automation is not the right tool. * Own release verification: smoke suites, environment checks, and a clear go/no\-go call. User testing * Plan and run usability testing with educators and internal subject\-matter experts, from task scripts through to findings. * Work with product and design on UAT, including feedback cycles with pilot districts and classrooms. * Own accessibility testing against WCAG 2\.2 AA and Section 508, using automated scanners plus manual screen\-reader and keyboard\-only passes. This matters more here than at most companies. * Turn findings into prioritized issues rather than a list of observations. Performance testing * Build load, stress, soak, and spike tests, with attention to back\-to\-school traffic peaks. * Set performance baselines and SLOs and track them so regressions show up before customers find them. * Help diagnose bottlenecks: slow queries, N\+1 patterns, payload bloat, front\-end render cost. * Report results leadership can act on: response times at percentile, error rates under load, remaining headroom. Best practices and enablement * Document and maintain testing standards, test data strategy, bug reporting conventions, and definition of done. * Coach engineers to test their own work. The goal is a team that ships quality, not a QA bottleneck. * Report quality metrics: escaped defects, coverage of critical paths, suite reliability. * Contribute to release process, code review, and CI/CD design from a quality angle. * Keep FERPA and COPPA considerations in view where they touch test data. **Qualifications** Required * 5\+ years in software quality engineering or QA automation. * Ownership of an automated test suite you built or substantially rebuilt, not just executed. * Proficiency in at least one automation language (JavaScript/TypeScript, Python, Java, or C\#). * Experience with a modern end\-to\-end framework such as Playwright or Cypress. * Hands\-on API testing, including auth flows and data setup. * Experience running performance or load tests with a code\-based tool such as Gatling or k6\. * Experience planning and moderating user or usability testing sessions. * Comfort with CI/CD pipelines and Git workflows. * Strong writing. This role produces documentation people have to use. * Ability to set your own priorities without an existing playbook. Preferred * Accessibility testing against WCAG and Section 508, including screen readers. * EdTech, K–12, healthcare, or another domain with real compliance and privacy constraints. * Mobile and tablet testing. Much classroom use is on iPads and Chromebooks. * Visual regression, contract testing, or synthetic monitoring in production. * Cloud infrastructure and containerized test environments. * Mentoring engineers on testing practice, or standing up a QA function previously. * Interest in special education, applied behavior a t * Adaptable and easily able to pivot as needed * Strong organizational skills and attention to detail * Self\-motivated and proficient at working both independently and as part of a team * Intermediate Microsoft office skills and competence in a digital environment * Ability to streamline workflows by leveraging automation and AI tools to enhance efficiency and accuracy Role KSA’s * Advanced knowledge of software quality engineering and test automation. * Skill in building maintainable test suites within CI/CD pipelines. * Knowledge of functional, usability, accessibility, and performance testing. * Ability to assess risk, diagnose issues, and prioritize findings. * Ability to establish scalable quality standards, metrics, and release practices. * Skill in collaborating across technical and nontechnical teams. * Knowledge of privacy and data\-handling requirements in educational technology. * Ability to independently select tools, set priorities, and build QA practices. **Work Environment** The work environment characteristics described here are representative of those an employee encounters while performing the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. The job is performed in a home office at a workstation with a telephone, headset, and computer. Home offices should be secure, quiet, and distraction\-free as possible. Your work area should be ergonomic, clean, safe, and free of obstructions and hazardous situations. **Physical Demands (Capability Requirements)** The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to enter text or data into a computer by means of a keyboard. The employee is required to sit for long periods of time. The employee is required to express or exchange ideas verbally to impart oral information and to convey detailed spoken instructions. Specific vision abilities required by this job include clarity of vision including reading small print and the use of computers. Specific hearing abilities required include the ability to hear, understand, and distinguish speech in person and over the phone. **The perks of working with us** Not only are you helping do good in the world, but you will be joining a team of passionate and exceptional people within a casual environment. We offer a full suite of benefits including: * Retirement plan options with company matching * Generous paid time off, including paid holidays and office closure days * Paid COVID\-19 sick leave * Health Insurance Coverage (Medical, Dental, Vision, and Flexible Spending Accounts) * Life and Disability Insurance options * Employee Assistance Program We are a proud Equal Opportunity Employer. STAR Autism Support (SAS) is committed to the principles of diversity, equity, and inclusion (DEI). We celebrate the differences that make each person unique, both at work and in the communities we serve. Using evidence\-based practices we strive every day to make positive educational outcomes accessible to all students and educators. This commitment is also foundational to our company culture. We acknowledge that research shows that Black, Indigenous and people of color (BIPOC) and women are significantly less likely to apply for some positions, believing they must meet every qualification as described in the job description. At STAR Autism Support, we value representation, and we are most interested in finding the best candidate for the job. We know that sometimes that candidate may be one who comes from a less traditional background. We encourage you to apply, even if you don't believe you meet every one of the qualifications described in the job description.

jobs.title: Software Engineer
jobs.description: **About the Role** GibbsCAM is one of the most established CAM platforms in the manufacturing industry, with a history spanning more than 40 years. We are looking for a Software Engineer to join our team of engineers who take genuine pride in craft, reliability, and building software that real machinists depend on every day. This is a strong growth opportunity for an engineer with a solid foundation in C\+\+ and a curiosity about complex, domain\-rich software. You will work alongside experienced senior engineers who are invested in mentorship and knowledge transfer, and you will have the opportunity to take on meaningful, challenging work from day one. The role suits someone who is eager to learn a specialized domain, comfortable reading and reasoning about code they did not write, and excited to grow their skills within a stable, long\-lived product. This is a fully remote opportunity for candidates authorized to work and residing in the United States. **Primary Responsibilities** * Develop and maintain software features for a large\-scale Windows desktop CAM application, working from specifications provided by Product Management and senior engineers. * Diagnose and resolve defects in existing code, with guidance from senior team members on complex issues spanning large or unfamiliar subsystems. * Perform repair, enhancement, and maintenance of software components, writing clean and well\-tested code that meets the team’s quality standards. * Participate actively in code reviews — both as an author and a reviewer — contributing to a culture of shared ownership and continuous improvement. * Learn and apply relevant domain concepts in CAM and manufacturing as needed to contribute effectively to the product. * Maintain currency with modern C\+\+ and software development best practices, applying them appropriately within the constraints of a mature codebase. * Contribute to technical documentation and assist in keeping internal knowledge bases current. * Consult with senior engineers and management on project status, technical questions, and implementation approaches. **Required Qualifications** * 3–5 years of professional software development experience in a production environment. * Solid proficiency in C and C\+\+; exposure to modern standards (C\+\+11/14/17\) preferred. * Experience reading, debugging, and extending existing codebases — not just writing code from scratch. * Familiarity with Windows desktop application development. * Working knowledge of debugging tools and the ability to systematically isolate and resolve software defects. * Understanding of core data structures, algorithms, and object\-oriented design principles. * Experience with version control in a team setting. * Solid math fundamentals and willingness to engage with technical or geometric concepts as needed by the domain. **Preferred Qualifications** * Experience with Win32, MFC, COM, or other Windows application frameworks. * Exposure to C\# in a mixed\-language (C\+\+/managed) application context. * Any experience or academic background in CAD, CAM, CNC machining, or manufacturing. * Familiarity with 3D graphics concepts or APIs (OpenGL, DirectX, or similar). * Background or coursework in applied mathematics, linear algebra, or computational geometry. * Experience with Perforce or other enterprise version control systems. * Exposure to large\-project build systems. **Education** * Bachelor’s degree required , with preferred focus in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or Mechanical Engineering. * Equivalent practical experience demonstrating the required technical foundation will be considered. **What to Expect** We understand that a specialized product like GibbsCAM takes time to learn. New team members work with our experienced engineers who provide direction and mentorship during onboarding, and we set realistic expectations for ramp\-up time. We are more interested in hiring someone with strong fundamentals and genuine curiosity than someone who already checks every domain\-specific box. Our team values steady, high\-quality work over heroics. You’ll have the opportunity to grow into greater ownership and technical leadership over time as you build familiarity with the product and codebase. \#LI\-Remote

This is a chance to create something new and lasting – with an iconic brand at its foundation. In addition, Scout provides competitive compensation and benefits to support your physical, mental, and financial wellbeing. Program specifics are detailed in company policies and employee benefit guides, select highlights: * Competitive insurance including: + Medical, dental, vision and income protection plans * 401(k) program with: + An employer match and immediate vesting * Generous Paid Time Off including: + 20 days planned PTO, as accrued + 40 hours of unplanned PTO and 14 company or floating holidays, annually + Up to 16 weeks of paid parental leave for biological and adoptive parents of all genders + Paid leave for circumstances related to bereavement, jury duty, voting time, or military leave #### **Pay Transparency** This is a full\-time, exempt position eligible to receive a base salary and to participate in an annual performance bonus program. jobs.title: Senior Site Reliability Engineer, AI Agents & Automation
jobs.description: **Ready to be a Titan?** We're looking for a Senior Site Reliability Engineer to join our Site Reliability \& Infrastructure Engineering team. We run entirely on the cloud, and this team owns the reliability and health of the applications running on top of it — designing the signals that tell us when something's wrong, and building the systems that keep ServiceTitan running better, faster, and cheaper as we scale. We make a huge impact on thousands of companies in the U.S. and abroad by enabling them to be more efficient and effective at running their business. Our Site Reliability and Infrastructure Engineering team centralizes the concerns of measurement and guidance so every engineer can improve availability and efficiency in their own area of the ServiceTitan cloud. We have a cultural foundation built on diversity, inclusion, and innovation, and we want you and your ideas to thrive at ServiceTitan. Come join us. **What You'll Do** * Participate in an on\-call rotation, using runbooks and playbooks to diagnose and resolve production issues (e.g., adjusting Horizontal Pod Autoscaler rules in response to load). * Design, build, and maintain observability dashboards and alerting grounded in Service Level Indicators (SLIs) and Service Level Objectives (SLOs). * Operate and improve our Kubernetes\-based compute platform, which runs the large majority of our infrastructure. * Work across cloud networking and infrastructure (Azure/AWS) to support reliable, scalable systems. * Investigate and resolve production incidents, including root\-cause analysis and follow\-up remediation work. * Build and operate AI agents and automation that take on manual, repetitive SRE work directly — not just tools that assist a human doing the work. * Partner with product engineering teams to review architecture and infrastructure decisions before they ship. * Write and maintain runbooks and documentation so on\-call knowledge is shared across the team, not siloed with one person. * Help define non\-functional requirements — scalability, availability, performance — for new systems as they're designed. * Collaborate across engineering teams to adopt best practices in reliability and observability. * Contribute to CI/CD pipelines and help teams ship changes safely and jobs.title: AI Engineer
jobs.description: AI/ML Engineer **Location:** Atlanta, Georgia **Employment Type:** Full\-time About Sobo Sobo is building an AI\-powered business operator intelligence platform designed to help small and midsized businesses identify operational challenges, uncover opportunities, and connect insights to action. Our platform combines proprietary AI systems, business diagnostics, connected data, and expert support to help business leaders make better decisions across operations, finance, growth, technology, and organizational performance. We are looking for an experienced Senior AI/ML Engineer to work directly with our Head of AI Product \& Development and help build the full Sobo platform. About the Role This is a hands\-on engineering role for someone who can take AI capabilities from concept and experimentation through production deployment. You will help architect, develop, test, and scale the intelligence layer behind Sobo. Your work will include model development, data pipelines, AI agents and workflows, platform integrations, evaluation systems, production APIs, and the infrastructure required to deliver reliable AI\-powered experiences to customers. This position is well suited for an experienced builder who is comfortable operating in an early\-stage environment, solving ambiguous problems, and taking meaningful ownership of technical outcomes. What You’ll Do * Work directly with the Head of AI Product \& Development to define and execute Sobo’s technical roadmap. * Design, develop, and improve Sobo’s AI and machine\-learning capabilities. * Build production\-ready AI workflows, agents, recommendation systems, and decision\-support tools. * Develop systems that transform business and operational data into relevant, actionable insights. * Build and maintain retrieval, inference, evaluation, and model\-monitoring pipelines. * Integrate AI capabilities with Sobo’s application, databases, APIs, and third\-party business platforms. * Improve the quality, accuracy, explainability, reliability, and security of AI\-generated outputs. * Create scalable data pipelines for structured and unstructured business information. * Evaluate models, frameworks, and infrastructure based on performance, cost, reliability, and customer requirements. * Translate product and business requirements into practical technical solutions. * Write clean, maintainable, well\-documented production code. * Help establish engineering standards, testing practices, documentation, and deployment processes. * Participate in architecture decisions and help shape the long\-term technical foundation of the Sobo platform. * Assist with the growth and development of Sobo’s future engineering team. What We’re Looking For * Demonstrated professional experience building and deploying AI or machine\-learning systems in production. * Strong proficiency in Python and modern AI/ML development frameworks. * Experience with large language models, natural\-language processing, generative AI, or related technologies. * Experience developing APIs, backend services, data pipelines, and cloud\-based applications. * Understanding of retrieval\-augmented generation, embeddings, vector databases, prompt engineering, model evaluation, and AI\-agent workflows. * Experience working with structured and unstructured data from multiple sources. * Familiarity with model deployment, monitoring, versioning, testing, and MLOps practices. * Strong understanding of software engineering principles, system architecture, databases, and secure development. * Ability to balance experimentation with the discipline required to ship reliable production software. * Strong problem\-solving and communication skills. * Ability to work collaboratively while independently owning major technical initiatives. * Comfort working in a fast\-moving startup where priorities may evolve as the product and customer base grow. Preferred Experience * Experience building AI\-powered B2B SaaS products. * Experience developing multi\-agent or workflow\-based AI systems. * Familiarity with financial, operational, CRM, ERP, payroll, or other business\-platform data. * Experience integrating platforms such as QuickBooks, Xero, Gusto, HubSpot, or similar systems. * Experience with AWS or comparable cloud infrastructure. * Experience supporting AI systems involving sensitive business or customer data. * Previous experience in an early\-stage startup or building a product from its foundational stages. * Experience mentoring engineers or helping establish an engineering function. What Success Looks Like In this role, you will help turn Sobo’s product vision into a secure, scalable, and commercially viable platform. Success means shipping dependable AI capabilities, improving the quality of Sobo’s business insights, building systems that can scale with customer adoption, and creating a strong technical foundation for future product and engineering growth. Why Join Sobo? * Help build an ambitious AI platform from an early and influential stage. * Work directly with Sobo’s Head of AI Product \& Development and company leadership. * Take meaningful ownership of architecture, product capabilities, and technical execution. * Solve real operational problems for small and midsized businesses. * Help shape the engineering culture and future technical team. * Join an Atlanta\-based company operating at the intersection of artificial intelligence, business intelligence, and expert\-led execution. Compensation and Work Arrangement This is a paid, full\-time position based in Atlanta, Georgia. Compensation will be determined based on experience, technical background, and the scope of responsibility. How to Apply Please submit your résumé or LinkedIn profile, along with a brief description of an AI/ML product or production system you have helped build. If available, include links to relevant projects, technical portfolios, GitHub repositories, or other examples of your work. Sobo is an equal\-opportunity employer. We welcome qualified applicants from all backgrounds and evaluate candidates based on their skills, experience, and ability to contribute to the team. Pay: $69,026\.02 \- $83,128\.11 per year Work Location: In person

This division works in collaboration with the Project Management, Infrastructure and Operations, Enterprise IT Governance and CalSTRS business areas in the delivery of quality solutions that meet or exceed the business needs of CalSTRS. This division manages and provides oversights to Data Solution Services, Web Solution Development, Solution Services, START Solutions Development, and System and Production Services. Under the general direction of the Manager of Data Solution Services (IT Manager I), the Information Technology Specialist II, in collaboration with Business Intelligence \& Data Analytics team, operates as the Senior Data Solution Engineer. This position is pivotal for the administration and operation of databases and data warehouses. The incumbent performs a wide variety of tasks requiring innovative problem\-solving where guidance is not readily available, such as data transformation, designing and developing data warehousing solutions, executing data science tasks, developing cloud applications, implementing DevOps practices, and integrating systems within the CalSTRS cloud ecosystem. The incumbent will collaborate closely with architects, business analysts, developers, testers, infrastructure engineers, and other IT personnel to ensure seamless operation and innovation. **The ideal candidate will possess the following skills:** * 5\+ years of experience in data warehouse design, development, and administration, managing environments such as SQL Server, Amazon Redshift, or Snowflake. * Expert in performance tuning, backup and recovery, disaster recovery planning, and security measures (data masking, row\-level security, encryption). * 4\+ years of experience in cloud architecture and ETL development, designing and deploying solutions on AWS/Azure clouds. * Advanced skills in implementing ETL/ELT pipelines (AWS Glue, Azure Data Factory) and managing CI/CD pipelines and DevOps practices. * 3\+ years of experience in data analytics, writing and optimizing SQL queries, building dashboards with Power BI, and using Python (pandas, NumPy, scikit\-learn) for data preprocessing, feature engineering, and predictive modeling. * 1\+ years of experience in AI/ML and prompt engineering, working with large language models (LLMs), designing prompts, integrating AI/ML solutions into data pipelines, and applying responsible AI practices (bias monitoring, ethical compliance). * 3\+ years of experience in technical leadership and problem\-solving, leading complex projects, mentoring technical team members, translating business requirements into scalable technical solutions, and communicating effectively with stakeholders. Every 12 months, based on performance evaluation, employees may receive a 5% salary increase until they reach the maximum salary for the position. jobs.description: **Location** ------------ Hub \- San Francisco; Hub \- Seattle **Employment Type** ------------------- Full time **Location Type** ----------------- Hybrid **Department** -------------- Engineering, Product, Design, and MarketingEngineeringData *Superhuman offers a dynamic hybrid working model for this role. This flexible approach gives team members the best of both worlds: plenty of focus time along with in\-person collaboration that helps foster trust, innovation, and a strong team culture.* *Preferred locations for team members for our Data Platform roles are our San Francisco or Seattle hubs.* **About Superhuman** -------------------- Grammarly is now part of Superhuman, the AI productivity platform on a mission to unlock the superhuman potential in everyone. The Superhuman suite of apps and agents brings AI wherever people work, integrating with over 1 million applications and websites. The company's products include Grammarly's writing assistance, Docs’ collaborative workspace, Mail's inbox management, and Go, the proactive AI assistant that understands context and delivers help automatically. Founded in 2009, Superhuman empowers over 40 million people, 50,000 organizations, and 3,000 educational institutions worldwide to eliminate busywork and focus on what matters. Learn more at superhuman.com and about our values here. **The Opportunity** ------------------- To achieve our ambitious goals, we’re looking for a **Data Engineer** to join our **Data Foundations** team and help us build a world\-class data platform. Superhuman’s success depends on its ability to efficiently ingest and process over 70 billion daily events to improve our products. This role presents a unique opportunity to experience all aspects of building complex data pipelines and systems, including contributing to the strategy, defining the architecture, and developing and shipping to production. Superhuman is a compound startup: we build many products as one integrated suite rather than standalone tools. That model creates an unusually rich data opportunity, with signals spanning our full product suite across both consumers and enterprises — and the foundational data you build connects those surfaces. The Data Foundations team is part of the Data Platform org, powering data needs across Superhuman rather than a single product surface. It owns the foundational datasets and data models that define the fundamental entities of Superhuman's business, serving as building blocks for the company's other data teams and data scientists. Behind the scenes, the team develops and runs large\-scale ETL pipelines that process petabytes of data and billions of events daily. This is a high\-impact role at the intersection of data engineering, data\-intensive applications, and data modeling, where the systems you build directly shape how efficiently our other Data teams can build their datasets. **What you’ll do** As a Data Engineer on the Data Foundations team, you will design and implement robust, scalable, and reliable data pipelines and systems that handle large volumes of data, empowering both product features and data\-driven decision\-making across the company. Your work will span areas such as ETL data pipelines, data lakes, performance\-oriented data processing, and ETL framework development. * Architect, build, and own large\-scale data pipelines and data lakes (Spark/Databricks) that ingest and process billions of daily events into reliable, decision\-grade datasets. * Design and implement solutions that keep data available, secure, and scalable across the platform, enabling both real\-time and batch processing. * Own data quality, freshness, and reliability for the foundational datasets other teams depend on, with automated checks, monitoring, and alerting. * Build the ETL frameworks and tooling that let other Data teams and data scientists self\-serve and model core business entities into clean, well\-documented, reusable datasets. * Partner with product teams, back\-end engineers, ML engineers, and Data Science to turn business questions into high\-impact data products behind business\-critical features, research, and experimentation. * Collaborate with leadership to shape the team’s charter and technical roadmap. **Qualifications** ------------------ * You have 3\+ years of experience running live production environments, including high\-load or data\-intensive workflows, with a focus on uptime and reliability. * You’re proficient in SQL and Python, with deep hands\-on experience in Spark and a modern lakehouse or cloud data warehouse (Databricks, Delta Lake, dbt, Snowflake, or similar). * You have strong knowledge of ETL/ELT design patterns, orchestration tools (e.g., Airflow, dbt, or Dagster), data quality frameworks, and CI/CD for data with Git\-based deployments. * You have data modeling and data warehouse design skills, along with a rigorous approach to data quality and observability. * You have hands\-on experience with modern data storage technologies (for example, Delta Lake, Snowflake, BigQuery, or Redshift). * You communicate clearly and collaborate well across diverse teams and stakeholders, turning business needs into robust data solutions and trustworthy metrics. * You bring a strong ownership mindset, taking end\-to\-end responsibility for the systems you build, from strategy and architecture through production and ongoing reliability. * You have a strong acumen for scalable, highly complex data processing, think holistically about problems, and raise the bar on your team’s craft. * You’re a self\-starting problem\-solver who thinks from first principles, manages priorities across multiple projects, and thrives in a fast\-paced, results\-driven environment. ### **Nice to have** * You have experience operating large\-scale distributed systems, as well as in data engineering and data modeling. * Experience with high\-throughput, real\-time streaming systems (for example, Kafka, Flink, or Spark Structured Streaming) at the scale of billions of events per day. * Comfort with data lake and lakehouse technologies (for example, Delta Lake, Iceberg, or Hudi) and managing cloud infrastructure as code (for example, Terraform). * A track record of building self\-serve data products, tools, or frameworks that other teams rely on. * Experience partnering with analytics, data science, or machine learning teams as a strategic data partner to productionize data and models. **Compensation and Benefits** ----------------------------- Superhuman offers all team members competitive pay along with a benefits package encompassing the following and more: * Excellent health care (including a wide range of medical, dental, vision, mental health, and fertility benefits) * Disability and life insurance options * 401(k) matching * Paid parental leave * 20 days of paid time off per year, 12 days of paid holidays per year, two floating holidays per year, and flexible sick time * Generous stipends (including those for caregiving, pet care, wellness, your home office, and more) * Annual professional development budget and opportunities Superhuman takes a market\-based approach to compensation, which means base pay may vary depending on your location. Our US locations are categorized into two compensation zones based on proximity to our hub locations. Base pay may vary considerably depending on job\-related knowledge, skills, and experience. The expected salary ranges for this position are outlined below by compensation zone and may be modified in the future. ### **US Zone 1** 175,000 to 245,000 ### **US Zone 2** 157,000 to 220,500 **We encourage you to apply** ----------------------------- At Superhuman, we value our differences, and we encourage all to apply—especially those whose identities are traditionally underrepresented in tech organizations. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, gender expression or identity, sexual orientation, ancestry, national origin, citizenship, age, marital status, veteran status, disability status, political belief, or any other characteristic protected by law. Superhuman is an equal opportunity employer and a participant in the US federal E\-Verify program (US). We also abide by the Employment Equity Act (Canada).

jobs.title: Automation Engineer
jobs.description: The Automation Engineer plays a critical role in the design, implementation, troubleshoot, and lifecycle management of automated systems supporting food and beverage manufacturing operations. This position leads automation projects that ensure safe, reliable, and efficient production processes while maintaining compliance with applicable food safety, quality, and regulatory standards and industry best practices. The role provides technical leadership across automation and controls, supports system validation and commissioning activities, drives continuous improvement initiatives, and collaborates closely with engineering, quality, operations, and maintenance teams to optimize control systems used in manufacturing, packaging, utilities, and facility infrastructure. **Responsibilities** * Lead the design, configuration, programming, and integration of automation and control systems, including PLCs, DCS, HMIs, and SCADA, supporting food and beverage manufacturing and packaging operations. * Apply hands\-on experience with automation platforms such as PLC: Allen\-Bradley (ControlLogix), Siemens, Schneider and HMI/SCADA: Ignition, FactoryTalk View, Aveva System Platform * Develop automation architectures that ensure data integrity, system reliability, cybersecurity, and compliance with applicable food safety and regulatory requirements. * Collaborate with equipment vendors and system integrators on system design, Factory Acceptance Testing (FAT), Site Acceptance Testing (SAT), commissioning, and startup activities. * Provide technical support and troubleshooting for process control systems, instrumentation, and industrial network communication to minimize downtime and production losses. * Lead root cause investigations and implement corrective and preventive actions (CAPA) related to automation and control system issues impacting product quality, food safety, or operational efficiency. * Monitor automation system performance and drive continuous improvement initiatives focused on reliability, throughput, energy efficiency, and regulatory compliance. * Develop and maintain User Requirements Specifications (URS), Functional Design Specifications (FDS), and detailed automation design documentation in alignment with food safety and quality systems. * Support system validation, commissioning, and verification activities to ensure automated systems consistently operate as intended, following industry best practices and risk\-based approaches (GAMP 5 where applicable). * Ensure all automation system changes follow established Change Management, Risk Assessment, and Deviation processes. * Plan and execute automation projects from concept through startup, ensuring adherence to defined scope, schedule, budget, and operational requirements. * Coordinate with cross\-functional teams, including Process Engineering, Quality/Food Safety, Operations, Maintenance, and IT, to ensure seamless system integration and support. * Mentor and guide junior automation engineers and technicians, promoting technical excellence, standardization, and best practices. * Evaluate emerging automation and digital technologies, recommend modernization initiatives, and support digital transformation efforts such as MES, data historians, industrial connectivity, and IIoT solutions. **Qualifications** * Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Control Systems, Computer Engineering, or related fields. * Minimum 7\+ years of experience in automation and control systems within pharmaceutical, biotechnology, or medical device manufacturing environments. * Advanced proficiency in PLC/DCS programming, SCADA/HMI configuration, CSV, and software lifecycle processes. * Strong knowledge of computer system lifecycle, change control, and FDA regulatory requirements. * Hands\-on experience with Rockwell Automation, Siemens, Wonderware, or similar platforms. * Proficiency with databases (MS SQL), and networking infrastructure. * Experience with data historian tools (OSI PI or equivalent). * Ability to read and interpret electrical and mechanical drawings. * Strong problem\-solving, project management, and communication skills. * Bilingual English/Spanish required. Synerlution is committed to providing equal employment opportunities for all employees and applicants, regardless of race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, genetic information, marital status, or veteran status. We are committed to fostering an inclusive environment in which all employees feel comfortable sharing their unique ideas and talents. jobs.title: AI Platform Engineer
jobs.description: At Sysdig, we believe cloud security isn't a compromise \- it's a promise. From the start, our mission has been clear: to help organizations secure innovation in the cloud, the right way. We created Falco, the open standard for cloud threat detection, and continue to lead the cloud security market with runtime insights, open innovation, and agentic Al. Creators of technology trusted by over 60% of the Fortune 500, Sysdig gives teams the real\-time clarity to move fast and defend what matters most. Culture matters here. We believe diversity fuels stronger ideas, and open dialogue drives sharper decisions. Recognized as a Best Place to Work and one of Deloitte's fastest\-growing companies for the past 5 years, we're here to raise the standard for what cloud security and workplace culture should be. If you have the passion to dig deeper, the desire to challenge convention, and the curiosity to build something better, Sysdig is the right place for you. ### **What you will do** * Build and run the MCP fleet — ship, secure, and patch self\-hosted and managed MCP servers for business apps and databases, and manage the MCP registry. * Own the agent platform other teams build on — the deploy pattern, guardrails, observability, and hosting substrate that let other teams ship agents without you in the loop. * Co\-own the Bedrock runtime and gateway — model access, cost attribution, content\-filtering guardrails, model pinning, and quota management behind an AWS/Okta\-SSO'd gateway. * Make AI spend and usage visible — build the Bedrock\-to\-Snowflake pipeline, identity\-matched, with usage tracking and threshold alerting. * Make the secure path the easy path — own MDM config, desktop client setup, credentials, and auth flows for non\-technical employees; build AI automations across Claude desktop, Slack, and Google Workspace. * Build governance into the platform — route workflows by data sensitivity, enforce least privilege and auditability, and keep unproven models sandboxed away from production data as configuration, not a rewrite. ### **What you will bring with you** * 6\+ years in software engineering, platform engineering, or DevOps, including ownership of something in production that others depended on. * Hands\-on AWS — IAM, ECS or Lambda, CloudWatch, and working VPC knowledge. Required, not a bonus. * Full\-stack range — backend services, APIs, CI/CD, containerized deployments. * Builder, not just integrator — you can write an MCP server or API integration from scratch, not just wire up a managed connector. * Hands\-on with LLMs — comfortable with LLM APIs, prompt engineering, and agent development; you've shipped something with them. * Self\-direction — you can take an underspecified task and figure out the parts nobody wrote down. ### **What we look for** * Bias to ship — and to automate whatever you just did by hand. * Ownership of the boring parts — upgrades, credentials, quotas, on\-call. * Candor — you raise problems and disagreements early, even about platform choices. * Judgment on buy vs. build — you'd rather run a small, coherent stack than a sprawling "perfect" one. ### **When you join Sysdig, you can expect** * Extra days off to prioritize your well\-being * 401(k) Retirement Savings Plan with a 3% company match * Maternity and Parental Leave * Mental health support for you and your family through the Modern Health app * Full health benefits package for you and your family The U.S. annual salary range for this full\-time position is between 141,000 and 177,000 USD/year. Your background and passion will set you apart, especially if your career path is different. *Sysdig values a diverse workplace and encourages women, people of color, LGBTQIA\+ individuals, people with disabilities, members of ethnic minorities, foreign\-born residents, and veterans to apply. Sysdig is an equal\-opportunity employer. decision\-making, and create scalable business impact across the firm. **Business Knowledge** * Engage directly with business stakeholders, product owners, senior partners, and technology leaders to stakeholders. * Demonstrated experience mentoring engineers and raising technical capability across teams. * Passion for staying current with the rapidly evolving AI landscape and the judgment to distinguish promising technologies from short\-lived trends. **Preferred:** * Experience establishing engineering standards or technical direction across multiple teams. * Understanding of financial jobs.description: **At Taazaa** Working at Taazaa involves engaging with cutting\-edge technology and innovative software solutions in a collaborative environment. Our employees often interact with clients to tailor solutions to business needs, working on diverse projects across industries.
